row.name: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars
row.detailed_description: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars is a free standalone version of Terraformers. Lead the first human settlement on Mars! Earth is sending its first expedition to assess the viability of human settlement on Mars, with the long term objective of terraforming the planet and spreading life across its surface. You will have to explore the planet, exploit local resources and develop your colonies into large cities. But make sure to provide a decent living standard for your people to retain their support! Are you ready to lead mankind's first steps on Mars? Choose your leaders Explore the planet Develop the first outposts
row.short_description: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars is a free prologue of Terraformers, featuring an exclusive challenge to lead humanity's first attempt at settling the Red Planet.

row.name: Wonhon: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Wonhon: Prologue is a prequel chapter to the main game, a hardcore tactical stealth action thriller set in Korea in the beginning of 20th century. Being returned from the dead, you have only one weapon: the ability to steal the life force from living creatures, turn into a ghost and possess them. Since you’re not protected by anything and can be killed with one shot, you need to move covertly and plan every step. The high complexity of the game makes you monitor each of your actions closely, since the punishment for being caught is a one-bullet death. Play as a girl who can turn into a vengeful ghost to assassinate her enemies; Conquer difficult situations when you are outnumbered and can be killed by one shot; Balance between stealth and violence, finding your own unique way to complete your task;
row.short_description: Get a taste for vengeance in the Prologue for this hardcore tactical game. Use your paranormal abilities to possess your foes, slip past guards, and fight enemies, as you balance between stealth and action-based violence.
row.notes: This game is a work of fiction and should not be seen as realistic or historically accurate. Please treat this as an entertainment product. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed. Please make sure to seek proper guidance or counseling if any of the themes concern you.

row.name: Out Of The Shelter
row.detailed_description: You have to get out of the huge bunker. You and the other players were locked in a terrible experiment. Only a few of you will be able to get out alive. You will need to travel the fastest route leaving the bunker through one of the exits, simultaneously fighting foes with improvised weapons. They will also try to stop you with all their might. 1) Players can win by escaping through one of the exits. Each exit is accessed with a special key. The player must go though the intermediate stage, depending on path chosen, in order to leave the bunker. 2) Dynamic gameplay stimulates radiation, which gradually accumulates. If you do not keep her level under control by picking up various medicine at, the character will be temporarily out of the game process. 3) In addition to basic weapons, player can find various unique ones, which contribute to shooter gameplay elements. 4) You can find multiple consumables, modifications and devices that make you stronger. Combining them should make your games feel unique. All items are locked in caches. Open them with 3 unique keys (should be found first). 5) Ability to create weapons and consumables on the workbench for parts scattered across the level. This helps to reduce situations where the player cannot get something if they just have a bad luck. 6) A large multi-level location with many workarounds. Players who know the map and love dynamic gameplay will be able to unfold their ideas to the fullest extend.
row.short_description: Out Of The Shelter is a multiplayer session shooter with quest elements. You must first of all get out of the big bunker using one of the methods. Act quickly before you get ahead of you!

row.name: 6 Feet Behind
row.detailed_description: Something is wrong. Mysterious strangers and a vengeful spirit are out to get you. You don't have any weapons. But you are not defenseless. The spirit does not spare the strangers. Use its wrath for your advantage. You might be able to survive with this tactic, but can you discover how this started? '6 Feet Behind' is a horror-themed top-down action game with a twist: instead of attacking the enemies or hiding from them, you have to make an invincible enemy collide with them. 44 levels with 4 different protagonists await you. Can you make it out alive?
row.short_description: Your pursuer is your only weapon.

row.name: Maze
row.detailed_description: Maze is a short psychedelic experience. Run and fight enemies in randomly generated levels. Features: Minimalistic retro visuals inspired by Tron and CGA graphics. Dynamic soundtrack arranged to accompany non-stop play Fast-paced fights Random level generation
row.short_description: Maze is a short psychedelic experience. Run and fight enemies in randomly generated levels.

row.name: u evade
row.detailed_description: You are u, a flying saucer having flown off course to a planet far away from home, drawn back thither on its own. In your desire to not hurt the native life, you intend to evade. Gameplay Auto-Scrolling through a procedurally generated stylised landscape, its 'assets' ordered newly on every game playthrough, you navigate u around incoming 'life': birds and 'low-pressure zones', using the controls. You cannot be hurt and if you collide you merely disorientate the bird or even the pressure. You will reach home in the play duration across 6 'levels'. Controls gamepad left joystick, keyboard keys WASD, keyboard arrow keys to navigate. gamepad button 0 or keyboard key Enter to start. gamepad shoulder buttons right and left to increase or decrease time speed multiplication and keyboard number key 1 to 9 to set the time speed multiplier directly to that numbers value. keyboard key Escape to exit. Play Duration You will be home in about 15 minutes. Background Originally intended to be released on a handheld with stereoscopic capabilities, release packaging was too cumbersome and thus 'u evade' is released here on Steam. Note This game is optimised for a screen aspect ratio of 5:3 (15:9). On 16:9 screens it will be cut off a bit at the top and at the bottom. Press keyboard keys Alt+Enter to leave fullscreen and be able to resize the window to your liking, press Alt+Enter again to view in fullscreen again. 3rd Party Assets Extended License for 'Lovers in the Rain (Full track)' (music playing through level 6) Extended License for 'The Lost Hours (Full track)' (music playing through level 1 to 5)
row.short_description: u, a flying saucer, flying home

row.name: SgyuinBaldo
row.detailed_description: ストーリー 決して豊かな生活ではなかった、主人公バルドは妻のクレアそして娘のリタと幸せな生活をしていた。 だが運命は慈悲を知らなかった。それはあまりにも唐突で一方的で理不尽な悪夢のように、一夜にして彼から全てを奪っていった。 魔族たちに家族と右腕を奪われたバルドは魔族の女性シギュンと手を組み、魔族への復讐の物語を始める。 ダークファンタジー×高難易度アクションゲーム！ 攻撃し魔素を奪いながら魔族を蹂躙せよ 本作のシステム、特徴 メメントモリ 「メメントモリ」を当てるため魔素を奪い合おう！ 剣攻撃を当てて体力と魔素を奪い、強力な右ストレート！メメントモリを放つのだ！ 魔素は巡り、敵もまたメメントモリを使用する。注意しよう！ レベルアップ 倒したボスから得たポイントを消費して各種ステータスを上昇させよう！ 銘 ボスを倒すとレベルアップの他に、銘を開放することができる！ 剣に銘を刻み、レベルアップと異なるアプローチで自分好みの戦闘スタイルを実践しよう！ 俺はただ復讐するだけだ。 このソフトウェアには、（株）ＣＲＩ・ミドルウェアの「CRIWARE (TM)」が使用されています。
row.short_description: 学生制作の本格アクションゲーム！ 魔族にすべてを奪われた男性バルドと魔族を恨む魔族の女性シギュン。二人は復讐のために手を取り合った。 主人公バルドを操作し魔族たちを蹂躙せよ。 全ての力を使って家族を奪った魔族たちに復讐を果たせ！

row.name: SPY ESCAPE
row.detailed_description: このゲームはエージェントとハッカーに別れて時間内にビルからの脱出を目指すオンライン協力脱出ゲーム。 ～Story～ 2000年代初頭。 一人のエージェントが機密情報を得るためにビルに潜入した。 機密情報を難なく入手し、帰ろうと思ったその時、ビルに仕掛けられていたトラップが作動しエージェントが閉じ込められた！ 10分後には警察が到着する！そんなエージェントを救うのは同じ組織に所属する変わり者のPCオタクの天才ハッカー。 ・プレイヤーはビルに閉じ込められた「エージェント」もしくは、脱出を支援する「ハッカー」のどちらかに分かれて脱出を目指せ！ 「エージェント」はビルからの脱出を目指す。 閉じ込められたビルの中で、ハッカーに「どこにいるのか？」「ドアを開けるにはどんな鍵が必要なのか？」「ギミックはどんな見た目なのか？」を伝えて脱出を目指す。 「ハッカー」はマニュアルとマップを見ながら脱出までをサポートする！ マニュアルやマップを見ながらエージェントを脱出まで導く。時には電子ロックのドアなどをハッキングで解除してエージェントを救い出す！ ～GamePlay～ このミッションを達成するために最も重要となるのはコミュニケーション。 このゲームでは「エージェント」と「ハッカー」という２つの役に分かれて脱出を目指す。 〈エージェント>はビル内を歩き回れたり、ドアを開けたりなどができるが、ドアを開けるためのギミックの解除方法が載った「マニュアル」や鍵や部屋の位置が分かる「マップ」を見ることはできない。 〈ハッカー>はビル内を歩き回ったり、ドアを開けたり、ギミックを直接見ることはできないが、ギミックの解除方法が載った「マニュアル」やビル内の情報が載っている「マップ」を見れる。 お互いで出来ることが限られている中で、相手と上手くコミュニケーションを取り、情報を伝え合うことが、このゲームで最も重要となる。
row.short_description: 二人で協力する脱出ゲーム。 エージェントとハッカーに分かれ、ギミックを解除しながら脱出を目指す。 一人じゃ出来ない、二人だからこそ体験できる新感のオンライン協力の覚脱出ゲーム。

row.name: Alphadeck
row.short_description: Pixel Trading Card Game with over 170 cards to play! Build up your Deck and defeat your enemies because it's time for BATTLE!

row.name: Pandemic Love
row.detailed_description: Fear and illness spreads through the city. You try to search for comfort in the people being isolated around you. Keeping the darkness at bay with small embers of light. Will you let the fear change you? You play as Trond, a self-reliant loner who's forced into quarantine for the next two weeks after making it out of Italy's lockdown. Stuck at home you meet other lonesome souls, isolated in the darkness, trying to stay sane. Together, at least. Who will you be when the quarantine is over? - Step into the shoes of Trond, a lonesome main character with a highly developed sarcastic coping mechanism. - A short story of 1-2 hours. - Branching paths. - Lots of choices that change the story. - More than 8 different endings. Will you let the fear change you? When the walls start creeping closer. Will you make the right choice?
row.short_description: A short visual novel about isolation. You try to search for comfort in the lonesome people around you. Keeping the darkness at bay with small embers of light. Will you let the fear change you?
row.notes: It's a game about illness, death and other adult subjects, such as depression or substance abuse. Even though some children might for different reasons know of these things, this isn't a game for children.

row.name: Hair of the Dog
row.detailed_description: Help Cummerbund Bandersnatch in this quintessentially British point & click comedy adventure as he explores the darker side of Victorian England, oblivious to its perils. Manipulate time, talk to a host of dubious characters and solve puzzles to get Bandersnatch out of a fix before it's too late. Full-length version in production! After three years and 50,000 downloads, this free game is finally getting made into a full-length adventure. Play the demo and add it to your wishlist now: Lucy Dreaming - OUT NOW Discover a dark family secret and rid a young girl of her nightmares in our first full-length point & click adventure, available now. A thoroughly British adventure After a mysterious explosion over Victorian London, Cummerbund Bandersnatch visits his uncle to find he's been experimenting with a new formula he's created in an attempt to give himself a 'good time'. Seduced by the promises in his uncle's journal, Cummerbund decides to drink the same formula and discovers that his life will no longer be the same again (at least between the hours of 8pm - 8am daily). Can he reverse the effects of the formula before it's too late? An hour of mystery, cannibalism and nob jokes Hair of the Dog is inspired and influenced by the classic 90s point & click adventure games, from its retro pixel-art style to its irreverent, sarcastic humour. This exquisitely voiced comedy provides an hour of frivolous point & click goodness like no other. Play in real time This game can be played in 'real time'. Meaning that if you play between the hours of 8pm - 8am some of the scenes, objects, actions and characters differ to those found during the rest of the day. Of course, if you don't want your game to last several months, you can enable 'Time skip' mode in the game's settings. Game Features: Control time – but beware it comes at a cost! From Louse-tamers to street urchins, you'll encounter a cast of colourful characters. Explore rich environments with an abundance of witty retorts to almost everything you can point your cursor at. Enjoy the distinctive and beautifully realised voice acting (English) Travel instantly between scenes with a double-click. Having trouble? Just hit the space bar to get a sneaky peek of each scene’s hotspots.
row.short_description: Help Cummerbund Bandersnatch in this quintessentially British point & click comedy adventure as he explores the darker side of Victorian England, oblivious to its perils. Manipulate time, talk to a host of dubious characters and solve puzzles to get Bandersnatch out of a fix before it's too late.

row.name: Qubie: Invader of Worlds
row.detailed_description: Qubie is a Community driven platformer about a rectangular alien (Qubie) who is on a mission to take over the galaxy one world at a time. Defeat the various 'Squares' and collect all the coins to clear levels and progress. Keep an eye out for special enemy characters. These special enemies are twitch streamers who have helped me and continue to help me throughout the development process. All music that is featured in qubie are original works by myself or my development team, so you can stream Qubie without fear of copyright infringement. We at CodeBreaker Studios encourage community input so please, if you have an idea, share it In the community discussion and we will do our best to implement it.
row.short_description: Qubie is an in-development platformer game designed to bring happiness and joy to all. Squash enemies, collect coins, and avoid various traps to progress through the levels. Oh and try to keep your cool!
row.notes: Frequent use of Foul Language. Use of Firearms

row.name: Veneficium: A witch's tale
row.detailed_description: In Veneficium, you play as a witch-in-training called Alice. Alice has to use her ice, fire and storm ability to platform around the world. Use your abilities to manipulate your environment and solve unique and fun puzzles on your way. Throughout her journey, Alice encounters many troubled witches that are in dire need of help. During the game, you will collect items for curing potions, find hidden witches within the levels, and use your spells to destroy dangerous Floating Crystals and Chaos Orbs that block your path! The simple, yet endearing and vibrant environment in Veneficium is definitely worth taking a look at. Will you help Alice on her journey to save the witches in her coven?
row.short_description: Veneficium is a cute and magical 3D platformer in which you help Alice uncover the faith of her coven. Alice has to use her magic to interact with different objects within a vast and magical world to overcome puzzles and obstacles.

row.name: Hero's everyday life
row.detailed_description: In Hero's everyday life, you need to play the role of a hero, completing a variety of tasks from give and bring, to kill monsters and bosses. Help all the different game characters with their mundane tasks and become famous throughout the fantasy kingdom as a great hero! Or just fool around and have as much fun as you can! The world is filled with various secrets, there are also enemies who are ready to break you no matter what, so arm yourself with a sword and hit the road. Who is a hero? Is this the one who gets up in the morning for an adventure? Or the one who fights for the good and prosperity? In general, you will need to decide which of you will be the hero and for what you will fight! The kingdom of fantasy is filled with monsters, NPS cannot fulfill their mission and therefore they called you a hero, and whether you are a great hero or not, it's up to you to decide! Complete a mission, fight monsters, kill bosses, or just insult the king and retire!
row.short_description: Who is a hero? Is this the one who gets up in the morning for an adventure? Or the one who fights for the good and prosperity? In general, you will need to decide which of you will be the hero and for what you will fight!

row.name: Salto
row.detailed_description: Sleep? Heck No! Time to catch up on your Exploring! Salto is a casual 3D platform game in which you explore the crazy world of your dreams. Run, jump, and glide through the world unlocking powers as you go. Reach high buildings or dive towards the clouds to make progress and see more. In two-player mode make the journey together and save each other from certain death as you cross tricky ledges and jumps. Skyscrapers loom all around you and the strange contents of your mind show up when you least expect them. Features 5 segments in the world and five levels of milestones to reach. Single-player and Two-player powers to unlock including double jumps, wall-jumps, pull, lift and glide. Milestones to keep you moving in the right direction. An interesting and fun world to explore. Checkpoints to restart progress after particularly tough sections. 100% Free - no in-game payments. Single-Player Mode Make as much progress as you can and discover hidden places. Play with a keyboard or with one of the supported gamepads. Two Player Mode Play local two-player on the same machine. You’ll need to be able to connect at least one gamepad to your machine. The game currently officially supports PS4, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch controllers, though other controllers may also work. Currently, one player needs to play with the keyboard and the other with a controller. (Connecting two controllers may work for some controller combinations but not all). In two-player mode two more actions become available as you progress: Pull: use your rope force field to snag your partner and slingshot them past you. Lift: boost your partner up into the air and over high walls. Have Fun! Just stay out of the clouds otherwise you’ll wake up!
row.short_description: The best adventures happen as you dream: Jump from between high ledges and buildings to explore the world above the clouds! Single and Two-player local Coop.

row.name: Space Survival
row.detailed_description: The milky way galaxy has become a warzone. A space empire called 'The Sheyertonian Empire' has been stealing resources from The Valeratonac Empire. The Sheyertonians will take as much resources from the Valeratonac at any cost. Even if that cost is the lives of many. You are part of the Valeratonac. Your mission is to find and take down their most powerful ships so their main bases can be taken down. Space Survival is a 3D PC shoote'm up game with large maps and various levels to complete. The short single-player campaign is continuous with cut-scenes explaining the story as you play. You can save your progress. Your saved games begin at the beginning of each level. There is a page clearly explaining the controls and there is the option to change game graphics qualities to match your computer's graphical capabilities. Read the manual included on the Steam game page for game-play instructions. Game Manual: 1- Follow the instructions in the game to complete the game. 2- Use Up Arrow Key/W to move forward and Down Arrow Key/S to reverse/move back. 3- Use your mouse to look around. 4- Shoot the enemies with your weapon using Middle Mouse Button to aim and Left Mouse Button to shoot. 5- Travel at galactic speed using Num 1 (on your numberpad) or Q (on your keyboard) to get to where you want quicker than regular speed . 6- Your ship has a cloak which you can use to sneak past enemies. Activate your cloak using the i key. If you attack an enemy ship while cloaked they will eventually track down where your fire is coming from and they will attack you. 7- Life support is how many hours oxygen will be generated on your ship. If you run out of life support you will die. Galactic speed charge is how charged your galactic drive is to travel at galactic speed. 8- Docking stations can be used to resupply on life support or recharge your galactic drive for travelling at galactic speed. Hold the E key or Right Control key and fly to the docking station to enter it. 9- Use the R key to repair your ship if damaged. 10- Use F6 to save your progress and F7 to load your last save. You can also pause and use the menu to save your progress and load your last save. 11- If you start a new game it will override any other saved games. 12- Saved games start at the beginning of the level. Developer: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi Graphics: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi Cut-scenes: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi
row.short_description: Space Survival is a 3D PC shoote'm up game with large maps and various levels to complete.

row.name: Dialogue Box: The Road Less Traveled
row.detailed_description: The choices are simple, picking is hard. In 'Dialogue Box: The road less traveled', you will navigate a whimsical landscape while failing to keep your sanity. The controls are extremely unintuitive and the humor is cheesy to a fault. I am a great salesman. Original physics-based challenges Dynamic story that adapts to your actions and choices Secrets with extra challenges for the completionists at heart Minimalistic yet charming visual style Way too many endings Puns I hope you won't hate me by the time you get to the other side. Have fun! TomerSSH. Trailer song: Canon in D Major by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 License
row.short_description: A rage-inducing skill based game with a dynamic story that unfolds following the player choices

row.name: Super Stupid Game
row.detailed_description: The total number of downloads for the smartphone app version has exceeded 70,000! The ultimate low budget stupid game that has created a big topic in Japan, the PC version of 'Super Stupid Game' is finally here! Paper-like characters rampage! Make full use of each character's special skill to defeat the enemy! ◆ Features of this game ・ You can play at no extra charge! Play a lot and open a lot of loot boxes! ・ Loot box system You can get a character by consuming the items collected in the game and opening the loot box! · Special Skill There is a special skill for all characters with a rarity of 2 or higher! Let's aim to clear the stage by making the best use of the characteristics of each character! ・ Equipment Card If you clear the stage, you will occasionally get an equipment card that can strengthen your character! Clear the stage and get a powerful equipment card! ・ Legendary Tower (for streamers) We also have a stage that seems to be a stupid game that 'cannot be cleared by ordinary people'! Clear all stages and aim for the Stupid Game Master! ◆ Game overview ・ Language: English, Japanese ・Game streaming is welcome! There are no particular restrictions. ・ Even with compatible versions, you may not be able to play the game normally due to model specifications. In such a case, please follow the refund procedure specified by Steam.
row.short_description: The ultimate low budget stupid game that has created a big topic in Japan, the English version of 'Super Stupid Game' is finally here!
row.reviews: “「超スマホゲー」は、グラフィックからBGMに至るまでフリー素材で作られているコマンドバトルRPG。超低予算スマホゲームと言うだけあって、「いらすとや」の著作権フリーイラストばかりで構成されているのがポイントだ。しかも、キャラのスキルなどもけっこうネタ系なので、なかなか笑える素敵なバカゲーに仕上がっている。ストーリーなども特になく、ステージ進行とキャラ育成といったシンプルな内容でプレイしやすい。投げやりに作られているように見えるが、実際やってみると内容的にはやり込み派の力作なので侮れないぞ！” アプリゲット “画面のシュールさからの謎の中毒性があり、何故か最後までやってしまうゲーム！スタミナ無しでテンポ良く育成できるのでやってて楽しい。あなたもプレイすれば「低予算のバカゲーで草→ココまできたし最後までやってやろうじゃん！」といった思考にいつの間にかなるはずです。” アプリ島　可愛いゲーム情報 “シュールながらやりがいあるコマンドRPG！スキルには連続攻撃や回復、攻撃バフなどがあるので、どのキャラを連れていくかを考える戦略性あるバトルが楽しめる。” Game With

row.name: Leyline Knights
row.detailed_description: Leyline Knights is an elemental action roguelike about fighting to reach the top of the Great Tree in search of magic. Wield arcane magic & swift swordsmanship to fight for your ailed sibling. Wield the Elements Manipulate elements like fire, lightning, and ice against foes imbued with their own elements. Combine elements to create unique abilities and adapt to the astral constructs of the Great Tree. Duel the Aetherblood Knights Standing against you are those born attuned to the elements, the Aetherblood. Face their attempts to stop your climb up the Great Tree and learn about their reasons for fighting for the Leyline.
row.short_description: Leyline Knights is an elemental action roguelike about fighting to reach the top of the Great Tree in search of magic. Wield arcane magic & swift swordsmanship to fight for your ailed sibling.

row.name: syGlass View
row.detailed_description: Your data in its natural form – dive into it! syGlass software allows you to view your data in virtual reality in its actual 3D or 4D (over time) form. We specialize in presenting the very large data sets generated by modern imaging techniques, so standard image volumes are a snap. Use our tools to quantify your data with enhanced precision, or import results for rapid correction in VR. Our mission is to help scientists explore their data more creatively and understand and communicate their findings more efficiently.
row.short_description: VR for scientific data

row.name: Little Moneybags
row.detailed_description: Do you ever dream of becoming a billionaire? Don’t you just want to live it up regardless of the price tags? Now in Little Moneybags, you’re getting this chance! Little Moneybags is a business simulator game for money lovers. Players will operate the character to start from scratch, starting from the smallest courier. Make money slowly, open a barbecue shop, a machinery factory, to a nuclear power plant! From scratch to the top! The novel investment system allows you to buy prime locations across the country! House prices and land prices are under one hand! How can a rich and handsome life lack cute pets and gorgeous mansions? A variety of cute pet top luxury homes! There are also exciting gameplays such as catching thieves, hiring operations, and upgrading luxury houses, come and have a try! Choose a character and create your rich empire! It's super simple to play yet hard to master. Now, you can experience an adventure journey from moneyless to a super billionaire. In Little Moneybags, Just start your business, maintain it for a while and let the cash flow to your pocket.
row.short_description: Little Moneybags is a business simulator for money lovers. It's super simple to play yet hard to master. Now, you can experience an adventure journey from moneyless to a super billionaire. Just start your business, maintain it for a while and let the cash flow to your pocket.

row.name: Reality's Reverse Side
row.detailed_description: Stefan is the Head of Non-typical Cases Investigation Department. It would seem a good position, but there are no other employees in the department, just as there are no non-typical cases. And the head of the detective agency is thinking about closing the department that was created for some unknown reason. But as always, His Majesty Chance intervenes in the matter: a strange murder confuses even experienced detectives, and Stefan who was very successful to be at the right time in the right place, manages not only to find the murderer, but also to expand his department, hiring gloomy and silent Zhonkey. From that moment on, the life of our hero finally turns upside down; the number of non-typical cases begins to grow by leaps and bounds, and they can no longer even be called non-typical – they are paranormal! Rescuing mermaids, trying not to go to the 'better world', finding yourself in the middle of a battle of centaurs, trying not to fall under the spell of sirens – that our detective has to do! Another case is to understand who Zhonkey is and what he really needs... Game features: 5-6 hours of gameplay Original graphic style Addictive detective story 3 unpredictable endings Bestiary that will amaze you!
row.short_description: Work is boring if you are the only employee in your department with no cases ever. But when work appears, life immediately rises upside down! Forever. Immerse yourself in a dramatic yet charming world of evidence-gathering, deduction and dramatic events on the reverse side of our world.

row.name: Morkredd Prøve (Demo)
row.detailed_description: Experience a taste of the award-winning, mysterious physics-based puzzle game, Morkredd. Play two full chapters of the game and get a glimpse of the dark secrets that await you in this challenging balance of light and shadow. The Orb is your fate... The Orb Calls for Two Morkredd is best played as a couch co-op experience. Heed the Orb’s call with a friend or prove your loyalty alone by mastering the unique dual-character controls. Your Path is the Orb You are the Orb’s protector, and the Orb’s light is yours. Survive and master over 60 puzzles while avoiding the shadows caused by your partner and the environment. The Orb is Your Only Friend An endless abyss of deadly shadows conceal dangers in this cold, dark world. Stay with the Orb if you want to stay alive. Gaze into the Orb Discover ancient secrets about the Orb hidden in the darkness.
row.short_description: Experience a taste of the award-winning, mysterious physics-based puzzle game, Morkredd. Play two full chapters of the game and get a glimpse of the dark secrets that await you in this challenging balance of light and shadow.

row.name: Space Ape
row.detailed_description: Space Ape is a fun side scrolling arcade experience that is just bananas! Guide Dimitri the Russian space explorer around asteroids, aliens and comets to get the high score. Space Ape is made by adults on the autism spectrum at the nonPareil Institute. At nonPareil, autistic adults gain digital technology skills in various domains and work toward building apps, games and items for the digital marketplace. While doing so, our members also acquire social and work-readiness skills preparing them for success in higher-education and employment settings.
row.short_description: How far can you take Dimitri the Russian Space Ape on his arcade adventure!

row.name: Love Colors: Paint with Friends
row.detailed_description: Relieve stress and restore calm while showing off your artistic flair in Love Colors, the paint by numbers pixel art game that’s playable solo or in couch co-op. Love Colors is the first paint by numbers game in the world to allow you to play with up to four friends simultaneously. Packed full of content, lose yourself in one of the over 150 stylish pictures from lovable themes including animals, food, people, cities and more. Love Colors encourages logic and creativity as well as activating fine motor skills of accuracy and precision to create a meditative experience. Key Features It's PACKED with ART! - Love Colors comes with over 150 amazing pixel paintings to get you started. Variety is the spice of life - Fun and creative paintings from a wide range of categories including food, drink, cities, animals and more. Collaborative Art - Play with friends and family; Love Colors is the first paint by numbers game that allows you to paint a digital masterpiece with others! Relaxing gameplay - Love Colors will help you unwind after a long stressful day. Calming Soundtrack - Soothing delicate piano music will help to keep you focused and peaceful. Tools of the trade - Paint using the Balloon or Bucket to take your artistic methods to new levels. Master strokes - Super satisfying replays show your masterful brushstrokes on your road to success.
row.short_description: Love Colors is the relaxing paint by numbers pixel art game. Choose from over 150 stylish paintings from lovable themes and become the Picasso of the pixel. Playable solo and up to 4-player couch co-op.

row.name: StarStruck
row.detailed_description: StarStruck is a fast-paced side-scrolling platformer based on the bizarre universe created by 36? for the StarStruck music video. The game features 12 weird worlds, each with a 36 second timer to complete, but don’t expect a quick and easy experience. Making it through the game will require master-level platformer play. The Story Far off in the perilous outer realm of deep space there is only one law; get... that… milk. The sweet and juicy milk is but the only thing that can save the human race. It’s raw kinetic energy has enough power to sustain our super-future societies and it is up to you, Spaceman Scott, to acquire it. The journey ahead will not be an easy one. Milk can be a treacherous and unforgiving element, and the worlds that you will find it are fraught with great peril. Indeed, some say that the milk is doomed. You will need to work quickly if you are to survive this journey.
row.short_description: StarStruck is a fast-paced side-scrolling platformer with a uniquely bizarre aesthetic. The game features 12 weird worlds, each with a 36 second timer to complete, but don’t expect a quick and easy experience. Making it through the game will require master-level platformer play.

row.name: Deadly Daycare VR
row.detailed_description: Student Project Deadly Daycare is the capstone game made by Little Chair , a team of 12 from the University of Utah . For many of us, it is our first shipped game. This game was made by 3 engineers, 7 artists/tech-artists, and 2 designers. Music and sound were provided by two students from the Berklee School of Music in Boston. This game was made with Unity, Maya, and various other software. Cute and Toony Virtual Reality Using virtual reality, immerse yourself into a toon-styled daycare! With weird and wacky elements, embark on a fantastic experience with adorable-yet-monstrous creatures! Creature Interaction Given a bestiary as a guide, explore the daycare for tools and toys required to appease your whimsical wards. From normal objectives like feeding and bathing, to outlandish tasks like rituals and witchcraft, every chaotic creature will have unique demands, attitudes, sizes, and challenges. Challenging Consequences As their caretaker, your main goal is to keep the creatures happy. Unfortunately, this is easier said than done, as they don’t always play nice. These creatures are dangerous, and if you can’t keep up with their demands, you may have to pay the ultimate price... Key Features A variety of creatures that each pose a unique challenge! A highly interactable environment for object exploration! See monsters in a new and friendlier light!
row.short_description: Deadly Daycare is a VR experience where you must take care of a cast of chaotic creatures before they destroy you and your daycare!

row.name: 凯尔文 - Kelvin And The Chateau
row.detailed_description: Introduction A fire destroyed Kelvin's home and took away his delightful childhood. Even after the disaster, his youth remained empty and uninteresting because of his tarnished family. The past has overlaid a layer of inferiority until he met his precious friends such as his pen pal Elledaz. When the final is over, it's time for him to go home. Kelvin is a free, pixel-style RPG. You'll play as Kelvin, meet the Queen from the City of Sighs, make all kinds of new friends, experience school life, and reveal the truth of your family. Your new life is ahead, so get ready for it! This gameplay will normally last for two hours. Instruction Move: ↑↓←→ Run: Shift Confirm: Space/Enter Menu: X Fullscreen: F4 Developers Iz is a high school student who is responsible for the game’s story, art and code. English Localization and Twitter promo: Carlisle You can find us on Twitter: Kelvin and the Chateau
row.short_description: My home was destroyed by a fire, and only my mother and I survived. Why me? After leaving his control-freak mother, Kelvin made a few friends and seemed to have a new answer to this question. However, his friends sometimes hide something from him.

row.name: Abyss of Neptune
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord About the Game From the creators of The Book of Regrets, Synodic Arc teams up with Abyssmal Games to create an underwater survival horror game. Set in the depths of the Bermuda Triangle, you are sent by D.I.V.E.S (Divers Investigating Various External Signals), a government-funded organization, to investigate a mysterious underwater signal. Are you ready to traverse the treacherous abyss and make it back alive? Survival Horror Explore the abyss and evade what lurks in its depths. Hide or fight your way out of every encounter against gruesome creatures. Puzzles Solve a myriad of puzzles to learn more about what led to the mysterious signal. What led to the events that transpired here? Underwater Utilize your D.I.V.E.S. suit to traverse an underwater environment. Make use of your jet booster, flashlight, and gadgets to scavenge the ocean.
row.short_description: Abyss of Neptune is a survival horror game set in the deep seas of the Bermuda Triangle. You are sent to investigate a mysterious underwater signal, but there is more to it than meets the eye. Do you have what it takes to survive the abyss?
row.notes: Depictions of gore, references to gore, mutilated creatures

row.name: Sprite Sequence Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: This is the first Chapter of the Sprite Sequence saga! A delightfully wacky story about the process of creation and being human. Follow our little hero as he tries to make sense of the strange and sometimes frightening world he's been thrown in. Key Features : - Story oriented - Light puzzle and platforming - About 10 to 20 minutes long - Hand-drawn and animated - The adventure continues in Sprite Sequence Chapter 2! This project started in 2016 as a way to try and make games like a webcomic is done : by releasing a small bit of the story every week. This improvisation based process gave rise to a game I wouldn't have wrote otherwise and I'm quite excited to share this first Chapter with you, that compiles the 10 first entries of the project. (Note that the weekly creation has halted after Chapter 2 but may resume in some not so near future)
row.short_description: A short wacky adventure that is somehow about the creative process. In this first chapter, follow a nameless hero trying to make sense of the world he's been thrown in.

row.name: SunSenSim™
row.detailed_description: SunSenSim™ ~ a simulation to sense the sun¡ isa fast-paced, beat em' up, shoot em' up kinda game! w a s d, top-down 2D, psychedelic bullet heaven... a singleplayer, space racing, open world parkour, PvE... m superhero combat survival, physics sorta game : ) The objective is to drift, dodge, & shoot; without being got! Flow fast, as you certainly can; crash with might & grace~ w = push a = left s = pull d = right q = flare e = block x = map scroll = scale mouse = aim mb1 = attract mb2 = repel mb3 = ghost Lshift = time enjoy : )
row.short_description: isa fast-paced, beat em' up, shoot em' up kinda game! w a s d, top-down 2D, psychedelic bullet heaven... a singleplayer, space racing, open world parkour, PvE...

row.name: Falnarion Tactics: Oathbreaker
row.detailed_description: Falnarion Tactics: Oathbreaker is an SRPG turn-based strategy game where you choose a side and fight through a series of challenging battles. Drestibell, Inelda, or Kessania. Which side will you choose to conquer Nerfelo and reign supreme? The choice is yours. Fight through a series of battles across several maps with an army of your choice to reclaim the world of Nerfelo and paint it as you see fit. Multiple factions, a huge roaster of characters and a variety of challenges await you in Falnarion Tactics: Oathbreaker! -Features- -Several characters from the Falnarion Tactics series! -21 unique characters per faction! -A nice soundtrack
row.short_description: Choose a side and fight a series of action-packed quests to dominate the world of Nerfelo in this SRPG.

row.name: Distancing
row.detailed_description: A very small game about social distancing in Covid-19 times, where you play a small scenario in daily life. You play a character that is going to a party. While on your way you need to try and keep your social distance to the people in the town. Before you can arrive at the party you will need to pick up some snacks that you can bring. The length of the game is about 5-15 minutes. The controls are very simple with the use of 'WASD' / arrow keys and the spacebar for interactions.
row.short_description: Distancing is a social distancing game where you are going to a party, but on the way you need to try and keep the social distancing.

row.name: The Most Boring Game Ever
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the most boring game ever. An experimental clicker simulation. Tired of fun? Just click away with a game that is meant to be boring. This game was made at a game jam as an experiment. We asked ourselves the important question. What if a game was designed to be boring? The results are here. The game is free to play so download and enjoy.
row.short_description: Clicker Simulator experiment to give you the feeling of being bored. Spacebar away and zone out.

row.name: Doggone Hungry
row.detailed_description: It's a Dog-Eat-Dog World... Doggone Hungry is a delicious game about eating food, getting fat, and being a dog. Your favorite toy, Quackerjack, is always getting stolen, and superior dog logic has determined that you must get fat to save him! Charm humans to earn tasty treats, scavenge for snacks, and increase your size in this short, delectable adventure. -- The Goal Dog must rescue his pet duck by gaining weight. Food can be found in two ways; through scavenging or humans. Scavenging: Food is everywhere if you look hard enough. Avoid eating in front of your owners in Level 1 (who don't want to put you on another diet), or seen by the lifeguards in Level 2 (it's a no-dog beach). Humans & Accessories: Other Humans are eager to dole out treats... for a price. They'll play a minigame with you with a treat on the line, but only if they like your doggie style. Appeal to them by finding doggy accessories hidden around the area that corresponds to their taste. There are 5 styles in all: Cool, Cute, Fancy, Stinky, and Wacky. Minigames There are a few different types of minigames and each will keep you on your toes. Each involves a different set of mouse and keyboard controls shown before you enter the minigame. Win to secure that bag meal!
row.short_description: Doggone Hungry is a delicious game about eating food, getting fat, and being a dog. Your favorite toy, Quackerjack, is always getting stolen, and superior dog logic has determined that you must get fat to save him!

row.name: CyberGrid: Tower defense
row.detailed_description: CyberGrid: Tower defense is a tower defense game containing HQ, Tower, and 3 building that generates resources. In order to build a building, you must have enough resources. You must protect the HQ from the Enemy. Each building can generate different resources. You must protect the HQ from the Enemy. If your HQ gets destroyed that the game is over. Protect the HQ from the enemies by clicking the repair button on the building. In order to afford the building repairs, you must have enough resources. It’s important to place and strategies how you place your building. Because you must place the building near the resource node. The closer you place your building to the resource node, it become much faster to generate the resources.
row.short_description: Tower defense is a Tower defense game containing HQ, Tower, and 3 building that generates resources. In order to build a building, you must have enough resources. Each building can generate different resources. You must protect the HQ from the Enemy

row.name: Monster Girl Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Story For many centuries, Monster Girls were ostracized and rejected from much of society. They were thought of as strange demonic beings that didn't have any sort of place in normal human life, but as time passed, so did this rigid stereotype slowly dissolve with it. Fast forward to the present time, Monster Girls have become an integral and irreplaceable part of human life, and can be found in many difference facets of society. One particular aspect that has drawn much attention (and criticism), is that of the domestication of Monster Girls as pets. In this game, the player will be able to experience what it would be like to have a monster girl as a pet for themselves. ***ALL INFORMATION BELOW HERE IS CURRENTLY OUTDATED AND WILL BE UPDATED SOON*** Characters There's the standard slime girl, nekomata, mouse girl, sheep girl – but there are also the more exotic and rarer ones as well: a caterpillar girl, a mandragora, a spriggan, with many more to come in the future. Gameplay / Features The core gameplay loop revolves around having conversations with the monster girls, seeing them in various situations (embarrassing, funny, lewd, etc), and interacting with them by way of a minigame. 3D monster girls that you can talk to and interact with open world to explore In-depth dialogues, with the option to skip them Headpatting minigame, as well as many others Encounter many cute and adorable scenarios with the girls Information I currently have the game organized by episodes, starting with number 0000. Initially, I was using that system arbitrarily just to keep track of different pieces of code that belonged to an earlier or later part of the game, but now I intend to structure the entire game's design and story by individual episode numbers – with each episode being one interaction (something like a story beat in screenwriting) that takes place with one or more monster girls.
row.short_description: A breeding simulator with monster girls.
row.notes: Monster Girl Dungeon depicts full nudity and various other sexual interactions. DISCLAIMER: Every sexual interaction is fully consensual on all sides, and all characters are 18 years of age or older

row.name: Atlantica Europe
row.detailed_description: Atlantica Europe is a free-to-play (F2P) 3D tactical massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed by NDOORS Corporation. The game's primary setting is a fantasy-themed alternate history Earth composed of a diverse blend of historical, cultural, allegorical, and mythological elements. The game world is primarily modeled after real-world geography with accessible locations on six of the seven continents as well as the mythical floating continent of Atlantis from which the game's name is derived. Atlantica, a powerful and magical civilization is the most looked upon producer of the material: Orikarukon. However, due to overwhelming greed, they have exhausted all the sources of Oriharukon and lost control of their magic powers. Atlantis disappeared but the remnants of Oriharukon survived. As the descendant of the Atlantians, you must discover the world and save mankind from the evil influences of Oriharukon, together with the mercenaries you meet on your journeys. Mercenaries - Collect more than 30+ mercenaries to aid you on your quests and battles! Create the perfect formation! Strategic Combat and PVP - Standard or Turn-based, strategize and defeat your opponents! Historical Content - Interact with familiar NPCs from stories of the past along your journey, some of them can also become your ally. Travel places based on real continents and its countries! Customizable 'MyHome' - Decorate, store items, train mercenaries, have a feast! Your home, your rules! Guild and Nation Conquest - Be a guild leader or unite a group of guilds and become a king of the nation! Quest and Dungeons - Over 20+ Dungeons waiting to be discovered and conquered! Full Customization of your Avatar! - Dress your character whatever theme you want, in fact you can dress your mercenaries too! Combine and Conquer - Conquer and wage war against other guilds who occupy other towns! Only the strong guild shall survive! Atlantica's publisher and developer, NDOORS Interactive, regularly releases new content updates which include, for instance, new dungeons, quests, NPCs, skills, mercenaries, outfits, equipment, mounts, and community features. Now, the game development and management is handled by VALOFE Global LTD and the and being supported by the VALOFE Operation team.
row.short_description: Atlantica Europe is a free-to-play (F2P) massive multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG), with a tactical combat system. Venture out in to the world of Atlantis where you'll find otherworldly monsters, amazing gear, and even more battle-hardened adventurers like yourself.
row.reviews: “Finally. A new style of non-AvCom MMO that actually works. Sorry Dofus.” 8.6/10 – Game Spot “Atlantica Online is the first full 3D online game developed by Korea-based Ndoors set in a fantasy world where the East, West and the past and future co-exist. Atlantica stands out from other MMOs by integrating turn-based battles, NPC mercenary parties and an in-depth class system.” 4/5 – Giant Bomb “A unique experience for a turn-based MMORPG.” 8.5/10 – IGN
row.notes: Contains: Sexy Outfits and Costumes.

row.name: Materials VR
row.detailed_description: MaterialsVR lets you interact with molecular models in Virtual Reality. Add planes to create cross section. See electron density isosurfaces and load your own CHGCAR files. Features Toolbar Start by selecting a molecule from the menu. Each model is accompanied by a toolbar above. Use it to enable rotation, disable bounding box, or add a plane that intersects with the molecule. Cross Section View You can set a plane to be the cross section plane by clicking the button on top. Only meshes on one side of the plane will be rendered. Electron density Click on the 'Molecule' title bar to switch to isosurfaces. From there, you may select a isosurface model generated from CHGCAR files. You can modify the isosurface level in the toolbar. Acknowledgement We acknowledge contributions by (in alphabetical order) Siddharth Ahuja, Emi Caroline Brown, Andong Jing, Sean Lin, Qiaoqian Lin, Noah Rebei, Sujay Shah, Zekun Wei, Jinlin Xu, Zhongshen Zeng, and Xusheng Zhang and support from the NCSA SPIN program, the NSF REU INCLUSION (grant No. OAC-1659702), and the NSF CAREER grant No. DMR-1555153 for support.
row.short_description: MaterialsVR lets you interact with molecular models in Virtual Reality. Add planes to create cross section. See electron density isosurfaces and load your own CHGCAR files.

row.name: Star Pilot
row.short_description: Star Pilot is all about Multiplayer Space Combat. You start with a Fighter and a Personal Space Station plus enough credits and items to fight in 3 different Arenas with 3 Modes. Star Pilot is Free; Win XPs and extra credits and unlock new Ships, Ranks and Ammos.

row.name: Bongo Arena
row.detailed_description: This is a turn-based strategy game with a twist on the traditional gameplay. The twist is, instead of directly controlling the characters IN THE BATTLE, you will be designing the strategies BEFORE THE BATTLE. When the battle begins, your units will follow exactly the strategy you defined, and all you can do then is just watching. Different challenges are presented in different levels. One strategy won't be able to defeat them all. You'll need to learn, adapt then conquer. Developer Note: This is my first game on Steam and I did this by myself. I wanted to avoid popular genres and do something different. Since this type of gameplay isn't popular, the game experience might be somewhat clunky. It's OK if you don't like the game and want to leave a bad review, but do leave your thoughts so that I could make this game better!
row.short_description: A turn-based strategy game where you design the AI commands for your battle units.

row.name: Dreams Of Adventure
row.detailed_description: Dreams Of Adventure brings you in a world of medival fantasy where you chose how to play and impact the world around you. Will you help a person in need? Want them to pay you for help? Perhaps... you end their life and take the bellongings...? The choice is yours! Map is 150x120 squares big (The finished map will be 500x500 or even 2x(500x500) Quests 125(currently) Party member - 2 (Currently. More members will be added in future as I work) nteractive spells - (Casting spells require to be pressed in a sequence in set amount of time to work with 100% chance of it hitting) Day/Night Cycle - Unlike most of RPGMaker games, day/night here determinate if you can enter a house freely or have to pick a lock (during the night. Some events and quests will trigger at night and quest givers/quest objective will only spawn at night (e.g.: Kill 10 owls (not an actual quest in game but for sake of reference) Statuses - Hunger, Thirst and Sleep (If Hunger and thirst hits 0 your character dies. As sleep goes down, so do your stats but it's not fatal) Prison System - Pay or Do Time World Locations 35(260+ inside locations (including houses) Blackjack mini-game (for those who like to gamble and have fun on the side) 2000+ Interact-ables (bookshelf's, drawers, closets, boxes, etc) Lockpicking 1000+ items, weapons and gear combined Smelting, Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy, Tailoring, Fishing, Leatherworking, Scribe, Inscirption, Survival, Woodcrafting, Processing, Jewewllcrafting, Cooking In-game Achievements (STEAM coming soon) Lots of random world events that trigger randomly or depending on your choices you've made along the way Fog of War - Rooms with doors are dark until you enter it. They go back to dark when you leave the room. Different Endings Purchasable houses - A place to call your own. Purchasable businesses - Earn income by owning land or busnies. Steal- You can steal items, money or gear from enemies during battle Flavorful sounds for drink, eat, sleep, armor and weapon equip. Spell Cool Downs 12 Kingdoms (not done yet) Item weight- Now items will have weight making player chose what to carry on him Bank/Storage- Players can store stuff and gold in banks for a small fee just like real life! Difficulty System - Now you can chose how you want to play the game. From Easy to Torment the enemies will have stats to make you walk pass them like a breeze or crush your very soul. 8 Classes: 1. Sellsword - An ex-soldier class that uses all kind of weapons and gear to rip and tear enemies on the battlefield. 2. Cultist - A harbinger of the dark forces. Uses various spells to afflict enemies HP and abilities. Can use blood sacrifices (kill friendly party members) to do massive damage and afflictions. 3. Paladin - Warrior of Light that strikes his foes with righteous fury. Users both abilities and spells to change the tide of battle. 4. Ranger - Utilities the nature and the environment to strike fear in enemies, unseen. Various traps and few spells that are learned from the time spent with elves. 5. Bandit - Always scheming, uses agility to strike their enemies. A bandit don't shy away form using less savory means to kill their target. 6. Cleric - Going down path of the Lord, you shy away from violence, but use your abilities to help those in need, while accidents do happen... It's a battle after all. 7. Sorcerer - Going to the school of Magic, you learn various school of spells to damage your foes from afar. 8. Commoner - A common peasant. (Not done yet)
row.short_description: Dreams Of Adventure brings you in a world of medival fantasy where you chose how to play and impact the world around you. Will you help a person in need? Want them to pay you for help? Perhaps... you end their life and take the bellongings...? The choice is yours!
row.notes: There are few indications for drinking, sexual themes (nothing graphic) and potential drug use. The game is pixel based so nothing can be seen, but, there are few locations with blood.

row.name: 临   第一部分“假作真”篇
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction In a world without humans, animals and plants have evolved into animo sapiens and become a community of shared destiny; In a world without gods, animals and plants built their own Ark to escape apocalyptic disasters; In a world where technology and culture blend, animo sapiens become a unified entity through conscious technology, breaking through the boundaries of 'material' and 'consciousness' and seeking eternity and stability. Under consciousness technology, the intelligent system originally created by animo sapiens has become the dominant force of the Ark, with those holding autonomous rights becoming 'immortals'; Due to a certain chance, developers attempted to crack the 'JingHuan celestial' with an exclusive Trojan virus, but unexpectedly, this virus developed self-awareness during the data transmission process; The current developer has reached an agreement with the Detective Immortal through consciousness technology: led by the Detective Immortal, the Trojan virus will explore the consciousness data space projected by animo sapiens in Taixu Fantasy, and ultimately make a decision related to the Ark. Game features: ·'CONFRONTING'is a science fiction micro horror puzzle game produced for RPG Maker MV, with a small amount of real-time combat; ·With the theme of 'Four Great Classical Novels', including three styles of 'steampunk', 'world painting' and 'weirdcore art', build a world of different types of technology and multi-cultural integration; ·The combination of puzzles and plot, the plot is to solve puzzles, and solving puzzles is also the plot; ·Characters can destroy some scene components through their unique 'cracking mode'; ·The game includes a 'ZhiPi system', which allows you to view built-in strategies; ·In the game, the 'system interface' is a part of the world rather than an independent existence; ·The vast majority of characters do not have specific names, only indicate categories or titles. row.name: 避雨2🌧
row.detailed_description: It is a parkour game to avoid the rain. The main character is a rabbit. You wake up in an abandoned cave, get a strange core, and then you will start your own adventure. Mr. Black Rabbit is a robot, which means he cannot touch the water, but a mystery man gives the Black Rabbit the ability to avoid water through the core. However, the mystery man needs the Black Rabbit to deliver this core to his temporary residence. Players must avoid the rain while delivering the core to the destination, but the road will encounter a variety of dangerous situations and bad weather, such as heavy rain, hail, lightning, wind, snow … This game is very simple. You only must use your four direction keys to control the character to jump, walk, slide, and fix. So, you can use your own inertia to overcome every situation.
row.short_description: This is an agile parkour game. You can dodge quickly to avoid raindrops falling from the sky and go to the designated place.

row.name: Fluff labs
row.detailed_description: Help Fluff labs conquer the world (of the snack industry) by mixing chemicals. In this first person logic puzzle game you need to figure out what colours to mix, seperate and react to finish each level. In each level you race against time to satisfy corporate to advance to the next stage.
row.short_description: Help Fluff labs conquer the world (of the snack industry) by mixing chemicals. In this first person logic puzzle game you need to figure out what colours to mix, seperate and react to finish each level. In each level you race against time to satisfy corporate to advance to the next stage.

row.name: Retroninjacyberassassin
row.detailed_description: The Cybersoul corporation has become the world's largest manufacturer and media group; using their financial power to influence world governments and create their own cyborg militia, Cybersoul becomes the only authority on the planet. Having purchased every media outlet on earth has allowed Cybersoul to maintain their control over the masses without question, except for one lone newspaper with a tenacious reporter with a fierce skepticism of the corporate giant. A newly drafted merger threatens to take ownership of the newspaper, unless, one of their own, a cyborg ninja known only by his manufacturing number, 6617, exposes the nefarious plot as he begins to discover it himself.
row.short_description: This shareware floppy classic transports you to an alternate early 1990s, where the first person genre began not as a 3D adaptation of the side scrolling and top down shooters that came before, but rather as an adaptation of the 80s beat 'em up/hack n' slash classics.
row.notes: Infrequent Strong Language, Drug Reference, Gore and Violence.

row.name: The Sand Dunes
row.detailed_description: - The Sand Dunes - The Sand Dunes is an action game with shooter and bullet hell elements. You will have to complete levels exploring and defeating multiple enemies. Delve into Diana 's last mission. Liberate your brother Amit and the other Gods from their destruction and vengeance desires. Explore the dunes. Find secrets and upgrades (new spells, or stats boosts). Complete different challenges in order to unlock secret zones or to continue the adventure. Defeat multiple bosses and survive chaotic battles using your spells, dashes and magic shields.
row.short_description: The Sand Dunes is an action game with shooter and bullet hell elements in which you will fight to save the remains of your people. The ancient Gods have been corrupt and they must rest.

row.name: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony is an adventure game that is merging the traditional storytelling with modern-day pixel art graphics. This version is a prologue of the full game. If you like this, you can buy the full version. CHASING A MYSTERY THAT IS UNEXPLAINED FOR 150 YEARS A group of people who set out to establish the first settled colony in America in 1587, mysteriously disappears a short time after arriving. They leave only an island name carved on a tree: 'Crowalt'. Now, the year is 1737. A young and ambitious adventurer Hugh Radcliff pursues the Lost Colony to make his first great discovery. Now, different people live in Crowalt, where he came to solve this mystery. He will hover around the island and definitely will get in a series of troubles to find what happened to the Lost Colony. CLASSIC POINT AND CLICK MECHANICS Collect, combine, and use items to solve puzzles. PIRATES ARE HERE TOO! Try to deal with routine pirate visitors of Crowalt and of course, enjoy funny dialogues. FOLLOW YOUR JOURNAL Hugh draws important things and takes notes regarding them in his journal. It will be updated after important events and findings during the game. MAKE CHOICES Lie or speak only the truth. COLLECT ARTIFACTS There are lots of historical items around the island, collecting them will take you to another level of… achievements!
row.short_description: A young adventurer Hugh Radcliff is in pursuit of one of the greatest mysteries of history: The Lost Colony. Deal with pirates, reveal conspiracies and make tough choices on your difficult journey for unveiling this mystery. Try the free prologue now!

row.name: just a game to test your lQ
row.detailed_description: You applied for a free IQ test on the Internet out of curiosity. On a quiet, dark night, 'World's Best IQ Test Specialist' comes to your house. You just have to solve a simple quiz. If you can. (This game is a horror game) Objective -Solve as many quizzes as you can while avoiding deliverymen, mannequin, and lunatic. -Compete on the leaderboard by achieving high scores.
row.short_description: Wanna know about yourself better? Apply for a free lQ test provided by a Nobei Prize-winning doctor! The world's best experts will visit your house. You just need to solve a simple quiz.

row.name: Dinner with an Owl
row.detailed_description: Announcing Owl Observatory The Owl is still hungry! In Owl Observatory, the prequel to Dinner with an Owl, you experience a completely new adventure and dive deeper into the time-twisting mysteries of your owlish host. Try the demo and add to your wishlist! About the Game Dinner with an Owl is a short classical point and click adventure. Explore the sinister mansion of your eccentric owl-like host, who holds his involuntary guests under a puzzling spell. Can you help them escape this nightmare? Then brace yourselves for some serious surprises! This is the enhanced 'Dessert Edition' of Dinner with an Owl, featuring: Full professional voice acting Eerie original soundtrack Twisted, looping storyline Classic point and click adventure gameplay Talk to weird characters in multiple choice dialogues Solve the mystery of the owl, to finally escape the mansion
row.short_description: Break the puzzling spell of your eccentric host! Dinner with an Owl: A short surreal point and click adventure.
row.reviews: “Dinner With An Owl is a charming and macabre little game with a simple yet intriguing mystery to unravel. It’s aesthetically beautiful and visually intriguing, and its engagement with surrealism and existential horror is both romantic and wryly self-aware. Anyone with a penchant for the gothic or for escape rooms may find something compelling in Dinner With An Owl, and be left wanting more.” Sufficiently Human “The music especially serves to create a very eerie atmosphere. From the piano music, you hear when first starting the game, to the somber background music that plays over the course of the entire game.” Keengamer
row.notes: Fantasy Violence

row.name: ProtoStone
row.detailed_description: ProtoStone is a card game with 4 different classes, local split-screen and over 150 different cards to collect. This game is perfect for the casual gamer with over 20 vibe/chillax songs or 20 heavily fantasy inspired music. Every card is perfectly balanced, as all things should be and classes have a unique identity to their playstyle, this is a offline game so no internet connection is required to play.
row.short_description: ProtoStone is a card game with local split-screen multiplayer (Offline), 4 different classes and over 150 different cards to collect.

row.name: 7 Years War
row.detailed_description: A 2D action/explorer surrounding the events of the French-Indian War in North America. Use your knowledge to pass enemy encounters and discover the events that led to a global conflict that spanned from 1756-1763. You will guide a French Infantryman through historical events that shaped our nation. Establish trade with the local Natives for weapons, cut your way through Ohio territory, and battle the Brittish army as they try to expand their territory under rule of King George III. Players can move around a map and interact with NPCs and objects that give information then, use that information to progress in the game by shooting correct answers to enemy encounters. Make your way through enemy occupied territory and battle a young lieutenant, George Washington. Hunt beavers for pelt and trade fur with Native Americans for useful tools that cut open new pathways.
row.short_description: Top-Down 2D action/adventure about the French-Indian War in North America.
developers: Jason Jackson, Justin Carranza, Jude Pierre, Evan Tomksy

row.name: To Hell With It
row.detailed_description: To Hell With It is a 3rd person hack-n-slash adventure where you play as Aella; who finds herself battling through Hell's more obscure realms in a 'down the rabbit hole' style adventure to retrieve her stolen cat. Rich & Fast Paced Gameplay Hack and slash through any demon that stands in your way. Spend your under-worldly spoils on powerful abilities and unique items! Unique Environments to Explore Fight through the numerous districts of a Hellish city in search of secrets, brawls, and leads for your missing cat; Purrsephone! A Humorous and Surreal Story After following Purrsephone through a mysterious portal, Aella finds herself in what appears to be the underworld's HR department (Hell's Resources). In order to track down her missing feline friend, she strikes a deal with this realm's exceedingly oppressive manager. What could possibly go wrong? Hell Has Some 'Friendly' Faces As Aella, you'll meet a few denizens of hell that you might be inclined to get to know. Who knows, maybe you'll make some friends that will last a lifetime!* *lifetimes are not typically long in Hell
row.short_description: Hack ‘n’ Slash your way up Hell's corporate ladder in this “down the rabbit hole” adventure to retrieve your stolen cat from the Underworld!

row.name: KingdomDefense
row.detailed_description: Demonic gates have been opening across the realms of Aeons. Dark king Yaldabaoth has been released from its imprisonment, and now it seeks vengeance against the celestial beings. You are the defender of Aeon, and you must protect the holy cities of Aeon and all its protectorates. The fate of the entire creation rests on your campaign against these dark enemies. This game combines tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Your objective is to defend the ally castle before the countdown timer expires. if the castle stands still after the countdown is over, the victory is yours to claim. Enemies will constantly spawn from the dark gate on the opposite side of the game field, and more powerful enemies will spawn in greater number as the countdown timer draws closer to the expiration. You can strategically plan to use the gold gained from slaughtering the enemies to maximize your chance of victory. There are five game levels and a tutorial stage to help you learn the basics of the gameplay mechanics. You can also save your progress at any time during the game.
row.short_description: A fantasy game that combines Tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Tutorial and five game levels. Single-play only.

row.name: Sheepy: A Short Adventure
row.detailed_description: Help Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life, as he explores a forgotten and broken world. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep. An Original Soundtrack Weaved into the world is an incredible original soundtrack created by Seeking Blue artists Yoe Mase, Hahlweg and Tal Richards (formerly of Echos). Mailing List Join the Mailing List and be the first to learn about the future of Sheepy, limited edition merch and more.
row.short_description: A Short Handcrafted Pixel Art Platformer that follows Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.

row.name: Traversing Traveler
row.detailed_description: Traversing Traveler is a game currently still in development by a small team of students. Some features may still be in progress as the game is in beta. Play as Taylor, a local alchemist in the town of Lumina. A recent disaster hit the area and now teleportation between towns is offline. Taylor decides to fix the routes by collecting runes in the areas between towns so people can travel the area again. Using potions such a bomb potion to destroy obstacles and a cloud potion to make platforms to jump between areas, Taylor has to make their way around to collect runes to restore the teleporters. As Taylor unlocks new areas people from various towns ask for help and get excited about the prospect of traveling again. Features: • Use bomb potion to blow up obstacles in your path • Create cloud platforms to jump on • Throw vine potions to climb up to higher areas • Use a shield potion to protect from damage • Interact with various NPCs that ask for help or give tasks to complete • When leaving the hub area, collect runes to fix the teleportation crystal of the next town over
row.short_description: Play as an alchemist named Taylor using various potions find your way around and unlock new areas to talk to various townsfolk who wish to see the path between villages restored.

row.name: Smithworks
row.detailed_description: You play as a new member in the Smithworks Guild named Smitta. She has always dreamed of becoming like the legendary smiths of the past. Their legacy and contributions led to their peaceful present time. However, it would seem that the guild was not as she had hoped for with it's questionable business practices and treatment of customers. Same-day blacksmithing? You have to be joking. Surely, it will get better right? Hop on with your fellow blacksmiths and friends and get through these blacksmithing contracts together. Smithworks is a team-based game that focused heavily on communication to succeed. How players decide to work together is up to them and every strategy is valid. Of course, you don't need to be perfect to succeed. In the words of the guild: 'If it looks right, then the customer won't notice'. Work in real time against the clock, to handle the heat of the customers coming in. Choose what orders to prioritize and how to do them to keep the guild and the customers happy. Features: Up to 4 player co-op Steam Achievements Voice Chat Procedurally Generated Orders Altered Levels for 1, 2, 3-4 player lobbies
row.short_description: Smithworks is a first-person 3D cooperative multiplayer game where players play as fledgling blacksmiths. It is a humorous and chaotic experience where players will need to communicate effectively in order to craft these weapons quickly before the customers get angry.

row.name: Goose Goose Duck

Play as a goose to survive or a duck to wreak havoc, with proximity voice chat, unique roles, custom cosmetics, and diverse environments to explore. As a Goose, complete tasks, report bodies, and vote out the ducks. As a Duck, call sabotages to hinder, and eliminate the geese. As a Neutral, pursue your own secret objective to win. Features: Proximity Voice Chat Cross-Platform Play - Available for PC, Mac, iOS and Android Unique Roles Customizable Cosmetics Diverse Maps & Environments In-Game Tasks & Mini-Games Multiple Game Modes Regular Updates & New Content
row.short_description: Goose Goose Duck is a game of social deduction for up to 16 players. Players are separated into different groups that are each assigned a different objective. Complete your team’s objective to win!
