row.detailed_description: Can you build the farm of your dreams? Grow plants, feed your animals, ride your horse, craft tools and constructions, and explore the map! Farming Engine is a Unity template asset to create survival games. This is not a full game, this is just the demo of the Unity asset store asset! Gameplay: -Player controls (mouse, mobile touch, and keyboard). -Inventory system -Crafting system -Equipment (attached to character) -Resource gathering -Character attributes (health, energy...) -Farming (Sowing seeds, plant/fruit growth, hoe, watering) -Livestock Animals (eat, grow, produce) -Wild Animal behaviors (wander, escape, chase) -Hunting and Fishing -Eating and cooking -NPC store to buy/sell items -Combat (attacking and hp) -Item durability and food spoilage -Storage boxes (chest) -Pets (follow, attack and dig behaviors) -Horse riding -Bonus effects (Consumable or equipment that boost stats). -Customizable Actions (streamlined way to include your own code) -Game clock, day/night cycle -Save/Load system Art Assets: -Animated characters (male and female) -Animated animals (cow, sheep, chicken, pig, deer, bear,squirrel, bird...) -Basic material (wood, grass, rock, hay ...) -Gathering tools (hoe, scythe, axe, pickaxe, fishing rod, ...) -Food (berries, apples, nuts, meat, fish, ...) -Cooked food (tacos, popcorn, bread...) -Constructions (fences, bbq, chest...) -Environment (trees, bushes, rocks, floor patterns...) -Farming plants (strawberry, pumpkin, pepper, tomato, wheat...) -Town models (lamp, bench, houses, shop stand...) -All 2D icons for interactable models
row.short_description: Can you build the farm of your dreams? Grow plants, feed your animals, ride your horse, craft tools and constructions, and explore the map! Become the best farmer of your town in this simulation game.

row.name: Psycho Bathroom
row.detailed_description: Wishlist the sequel - Cyber Paradise - Now! More reviews: 'PB is an entertaining and very well put together game. I enjoyed the mechanics of this fighter and the story is one I believe should be heard.' - The Paladin Club (Steam Curator) “I love the story so far it's cute but also really tragic and relatable” - Mayshing, founder of Altabe Studio 'Wasn't sure what I was getting myself in for with this one but it's great! It's a platformer that's all boss fights and quirky toilet humour. My only complaint? Needs to be longer! Should not be free.' - CSH Picone (Steam Curator) 'Worthwhile lessons about bathroom hygiene form the backbone of this fun, toilet-themed boss rush game with a surprisingly sweet story. Satisfying combat, good variety and challenge await.' - indie recommendations (Steam Curator) 'Psycho Bathroom is great, with a sense of humour added to it. as you take on a variety of boss fights which enhances your experience with a story that makes you feel more immersive within the game.' - Weird F'n Games (Steam Curator) 'A sentient toothbrush fighting against poop-based monsters to save the hygiene of his master, in a bizarre and addictive 2D action boss-rush with VN elements and quotes from scientific journals.' - Crazy Bloody Action Games (Steam Curator) 'It is fast, fluid and addictive; it is all made better by the fact that the game is free. Not free-to-play; free for life, like there are no extra costs, which surprised me because combat is robust.' - Syndicate Y (Gaming media site) A boss rush game with a dark comedic storyline about outcasts, hopes and friendships. In the bathroom you reside in, your toilet lid is broken. Every toilet flush is splashing aerosols all over the place. You, as a toothbrush, must eradicate the threat and protect your master. Along the way, you'll upgrade your gear, meet new buddies and learn the absurd world through your master's story. Swift combats Toothpaste is your sword, and mouthwash is your holy water. Slash the filthy enemies in their faces, attack them from below, hit and bounce on their heads (homage to Hollow Knight!) Perform combo streaks to activate your mouthwash for critical hits and speed buff. Unlock new skills, buy gear and upgrades Win the battle and keep your master clean. In return, your healthy master will work hard and split his earnings with you. Use it to buy equipment, upgrade and unlock new abilities. If you want, get a new toilet lid to stop the filth from coming out once and for all (or not?). Friends With Unique Abilities Along the way, you will meet new friends who will assist you in your battles. Put their unique abilities to good use! A black comedy about outcasts, hopes and friendships Chat heart to heart with your master during the tooth-brushing session after every battle. Explore his bitter-sweet story - well, sweet only if you can beat the game. Otherwise, it’d just be a bitter story. Unlimited Levels There’re 12 unique bosses. Every time you've beaten all of them, they will make a comeback. They will get stronger and probably with evolving move-sets. Your previous tactics may no longer work. How Long To Beat It takes around 1- 1.5 hours to see the ending of the story. But the real fun starts after you’ve beaten the game! Game Features Information about real-life toilet plumes. Tight control allows you to move around and strike swiftly. 12 bosses and numerous minions. Shop - buy equipment, upgrades, unlock new abilities. Unlimited levels with increasing difficulty. A dark but comic story. 4 dumbfounding animated cutscenes.
row.short_description: Psycho Bathroom is a boss rush game with a dark comedic storyline about outcasts, hopes and friendships. Your job as a toothbrush is to fight toilet plumes and protect your master. Along the way, you'll upgrade your gear, meet new buddies and learn the absurd world through your master's story.
row.reviews: “Somehow, this free (?!) game about a toothbrush fighting off poo to protect its owner from viruses ended up being one of the most emotionally satisfying games I've ever played.” Winston Tang (Creative Director at Samurai Punk) “Psycho Bathroom is a game that introduces emotional topics, like feelings of being an outsider, but cleverly veils that behind bathroom humor.” Video Game Reviewer Extraordinaire “If you like a Cuphead intensity swirled in with toilet humor that’s more germaphobe than straight up disgusting. If you love an unexpected turn of events that will get you going emotionally… And lose it psychologically, then hold onto your seat for that’s the shi* right there~” DaRevieweD (Steam Curator)

row.name: マグネクション磁
row.detailed_description: It is a 3D action game 'マグネクション磁' for PC! A completely new magnetic force operation 3D action game presented by the team 'HOT'. Release! float! Stick! Full of new gimmicks using magnetic force! In this game, by applying a magnetic force to an object on the stage or wearing a magnetic force by itself, the stage is captured using the repulsive force and attractive force of the north and south poles. Please play the game made by the three college students! !!
row.short_description: This is a Magnetic force operation system 3D action game. By changing the objects on the stage and their own poles, we will capture various stages using the repulsive force and attractive force of the magnetic force.

row.name: Society's Paradigms
row.detailed_description: story The Golden God is soon to be left out of his prison. The blood moon rises as the believers pray for salvation... World generation No other playthrough is the same as the previous one, so you have to discover new possibilities to finish your job Choices matter Side with the ruling party to restore the order of a crumbling world or lead a new movement governed by your own ideas and beliefs. Obtain different outcomes in certain situations depending on your own actions Fast-Paced Combat Immersive hack and slash combat and satisfying combos Skills Discover new skills depending on how you play the game, so you can make each run unique
row.short_description: Society’s Paradigms is an action-packed social commentary based on the innovative combination of Rogue-lite and RPG elements. Explore a randomly generated world to obtain new skills and abilities. Experiment and combine passive and active skills to achieve insane combos and satisfying combat.
row.notes: Pixelart punching and slashing

row.name: Get Lost In Nature With Luke
row.detailed_description: America's East Coast is home to some of the most beautiful canyons, beaches, mountains, gorges, mountains, and rivers. It is especially famous during the Fall, when the leaves turn to impossibly beautiful shades of red, orange and yellow. This experience will allow you to visit some of these beautiful locations, hear a guided narration, and get up and even walk about a bit! At a time when travel, especially international travel, is so hard, we want to make you feel truly transported. We want you to feel the vitality, the rawness of these beautiful places in the same way you'd feel if you were visiting these places for the first time. New places will be added frequently, even extending outside the United States. Come and be part of this exciting journey with us!
row.short_description: Come and join Luke, and get lost in beautiful scenic locations, including gorges, rivers, mountains, canyons, beaches, and waterfalls in the United States and around the world.

row.name: House Builder: First Job
row.detailed_description: House Builder: First Job We invite you to try out the prologue of House Builder! The released version includes as many as two complete, free levels for exploration! In this version of the game, you'll have to face hostile arctic temperatures and dangerous fauna in the middle of a tropical paradise. During this experience, you will learn the real methods of raising primitive structures. Get ready for an amazing journey! Arctic Find out how construction has been build in extremely low temperature. Survive night in the Arctic desolation. Tropical Forest Learn the ways of constructing shelter in tropical forest. See full process of preparing materials needed to raise neolithic shack. Use special tools and stations to refine gathered materials. Discover and collect new skills fasting up building process. Road to full version In full release of the game, you will gain access to varied levels spanning multiple historical eras. Every level is unique and presents a different approach to building construction all over the world. From simple shacks to luxury modern villas.
row.short_description: Become a one-man construction crew! Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna!

row.name: Greedy Goblin
row.detailed_description: GOBLIN KING HERE! LISTEN UP MINIONS! Your job is to loot 'n scoot through the ruins and bring me a hoard of gold! But most importantly, you need to collect my CURSED ARTIFACTS ! They should help you take care of those pesky humans while makin' the scootin part real easy.. Here's the plan... LOOT Loot cursed artifacts to get a taste of what its like to be me! Loot gold... Because I told you so! SCOOT Scoot past those brainless humans.. If they make quick work of you, I can easily send a replacement.. Scoot through the ruins and make sure you use the artifacts to get more gold. HEY you listening to me kid?! GET MOVING!
row.short_description: Greedy Goblin is a 3D 'Looter Scooter!' LOOT gold and cursed artifacts to please the goblin king, and SCOOT past dangerous humans to solve puzzles and escape the ruins! Created by a University of Utah student developer team.

row.name: Gravity Snake
row.detailed_description: More Games About the Game Get ready for a fresh twist on a classic arcade experience! Gravity Snake is an engaging blend of the iconic snake game and platforming puzzles, where gravity is your ally—and your enemy. As you guide your snake to eat all the apples in 20 carefully crafted levels, it will grow in size, adding to both the challenge and fun. But beware—your snake can’t reverse direction and will fall if any part of its body is unsupported, making each move a careful calculation. Your mission is to navigate tricky environments, avoid dangerous obstacles, and reach your ultimate goal—finding your lost love. But with gravity and the length of your snake working against you, you'll need to use strategy to avoid getting entangled in your own body or touching harmful elements scattered throughout the levels. Key Features : Unique Snake-Platforming Mechanics : Experience a whole new way to play snake, with gravity adding a puzzle-solving twist. Challenging Levels : 20 diverse levels that increase in difficulty as you grow longer and navigate treacherous terrain. Strategic Gameplay : Plan every move carefully to avoid trapping yourself or falling into hazards. Minimalistic Design : Simple, charming visuals and intuitive controls ensure a fun, casual experience. Free to Play : Enjoy hours of gameplay with no cost attached. Whether you're a fan of classic arcade games or looking for something fresh and challenging, Gravity Snake is a delightful puzzle game that will keep you coming back for more. Try it out for free on Steam today!
row.short_description: Gravity Snake is a 2D puzzle game that follows the adventures of a cute snake able to fold its body to squeeze through hard-to-reach areas. To complete a level, you need to collect all the apples scattered around it.

row.name: ACROBATIC CAR
row.detailed_description: A Speedrun Game It's a physics-based driving platformer inspired by the classic game Elasto Mania. It's completly free; No microtransactions, No paywalls. Just a pure fun experience that captures the spirit of 2000's classic games! -Over 90 Challenging Levels -Level Editor The Story --------------------- On May 5, 1961, America launched its first astronaut into space, following the Soviet Union's earlier achievements. This mission was known as Freedom 7, also referred to as Mercury-Redstone 3. Unfortunately, the mission failed because the spaceship was unable to navigate the hazards on Mercury's surface. 60 years later, on the same day in 2021, NASA finally invented a sophisticated vehicle called Acrobatic Car, so the mission has continued. 7 adventurous clowns, willing to leave Earth, were sent to Mercury to claim the Redstone and bring it back. They sought to prove their heroism and show that they were more than just 'nothing but clowns'. The 7 clowns were professional and trained enough for the mission, but once they landed, they realised they were not the only ones going for the Redstone, another clown named SkilledBird was seeking it too. He was so skilled that his abilities had never been seen before. Rumours say that he is an alien from another planet, others say that he was a champion in the world of Elasto Mania but came to this world for an unknown reason. Whatever the truth is, they have to beat him, be faster than him to get to the Redstone before he does. ---------------------
row.short_description: A 2D physics-based car game inspired by the classic Elasto Mania, reimagined with a modern twist mechanics featuring turbo, honking, gravity flips, varied terrains, hazards, and much more + a built-in [Level Editor].

row.name: SnOut
row.detailed_description: Compete for the top score in this combination of two classic arcade games! The idea Is Simple You control the snake Gain length (and points) for the ball hitting your body Body hits power up the ball to destroy blocks and create space Just go for as long as you can! You lose if your head hits the ball, the wall, or your own body! Instant Action! Easy-to-learn, Hard-to-master! 16 colour palettes and 4 block styles to unlock! Work your way up the online highscores (Monthly & All-Time)! Supports the left-handed (swaps arrow keys for WASD) Supports the left-handed AZERTY users (swaps WASD for QZSD) Supports you as you sob gently after losing just before your previous high score Available Completely Free!
row.short_description: Compete for the top score in this combination of two classic arcade games!

row.name: Cyberplug
row.detailed_description: In Cyberplug, you will run across the city clearing different levels, using the fast electric powers of the main character, in order to beat the F.R.O.G. Corporation that rules the city with a tight fist. These electric powers will be specially useful in the different settings such as the sewers or the suburbs where you will encounter different obstacles to beat at high speeds! Frenetic Plataformer : Lateral movement based in the character's speed. Movement skills : Beat different challenges with a variety of powers that will boost the speed. Overcome threats : The corporation's robots will try to stop you, but you will be able to use them to obtain impulse and soar through the level. Replayability : Once a level is finished, you will be able to come back to it and attempt to race beat your best time in a 'shadow mode', or obtain the collectables you missed. The comic hand drawn art style with contrasting colors, combined with the frenetic electric mechanics and gameplay, give the game a unique feeling within the cyberpunk theme.
row.short_description: Cyberplug is a 2D platformer, where you control an electric being capable of moving at high speed and use electricity to advance through enemies and destroy a corporation that rules the cyberpunk themed city.

row.name: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers
row.detailed_description: Four strangers. A train. A masked ball. A tale of dark and troubling things in four acts. THE SILENT ROOM In a luxurious hotel room in Rome, freshly arrived from Turin, Carlo awaits for his lover Patrick to arrive. However, as the shadow of fascism looms ever larger, the tension of meeting in constant hiding is beginning to take its toll. THE SLOW VANISHING OF LADY WINTERBOURNE Lady Winterbourne has lost her husband in a tragic accident. Now letters from pretenders to her vast fortune keep arriving every day at her mansion, yet the only thing she's interested in is the bottle of laudanum in her cabinet. THE NAMELESS RITUAL Harassed, ridiculed and belittled by his peers, Dr. Jordan Samuels has resorted to the occult sciences in a desperate attempt to turn the tables on his tormentors. But is he truly ready to face the Guardian of the Threshold? IF ON A WINTER'S NIGHT As much as Laylah enjoys her job, sometimes she yearns for a bit of variety to distract her from her daily routine -- even if it means going against her very powerful bosses' orders. Controls: Left click = Walk / Talk / Look / Interact. Right click = Cancel item action. Esc = Pause / Options Menu. Alt + Enter = Toggle fullscreen mode. Alt + Ctrl = Toggle cursor lock when in windowed mode. Brought to you by: Laura Hunt: coding, writing, music, sound design. Thomas Möhring: art, animations, cutscenes.
row.short_description: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure with horror elements that explores the stories of four characters in a masked ball taking place aboard a train in the late 1920s.
row.reviews: “Delicious! What a ghastly little gem.” Eurogamer “Horror hovers on the edges of these tragedies, seeping from the cracks of a reality fractured by sudden calamity and the mind’s inability to deal with the fallout.” The AV Club “It’s a masterful blend of existential horror and mystery that wields its compact, pixelated form like a weapon, weaving together these short disparate stories into a cohesive whole.” PC Gamer
row.notes: This game contains references to thematic elements such as racism, homophobia, mental illness, murder and suicide.

row.name: Carma
row.detailed_description: Out drive your friends in fast, arcade-style vehicle combat, using power-ups, killstreaks, and the environment to smash your foes! Battle across a miniature world, avoiding dangers and earning the gods favour to level up and unlock a wide range of customisables to help you stand out from the crowd. Discover a diverse set of themed customisations for you to unlock through earning XP and favour from the gods of the universe. Spend favour on Toolboxes and test your luck to see what customisations you will hit the planets with. Fast paced hectic combat awaits in Carma. Use a wide variety of offensive and defensive powerups to defeat your opponents and build up a killstreak. Hit kill milestones and unleash hectic killstreaks upon the game to twist the odds in your favour. Take the fight to an extraordinary environment crafted by the gods. Bright popping colours and candied obstacles scattered across the planet can be used to your advantage, with routes handcrafted to allow you to dash around the planet quickly and make narrow escapes from danger.
row.short_description: Out drive your friends in fast, arcade-style vehicle combat, using power-ups, killstreaks, and the environment to smash your foes! Battle across a miniature world, avoiding dangers and earning the gods favour to level up and unlock a wide range of customisables to help you stand out from the crowd.

row.name: Wonhon: The Beginning
row.detailed_description: Wonhon is a paranormal stealth-action and tactics game about revenge in a 1920’s era Korea. The main character is a Korean girl who was killed along with her family during an attack on their village. Jeoseung Saja, the God of Death, gives the girl the paranormal ability to turn into a ghost and possess living creatures. Without weapons to protect herself, the girl must rely on stealth, finding any opportunity to use the power to transform into a ghost in order to exact her revenge. A Girl and a Ghost: A defenseless child surrounded by enemies, the game’s phantasmal protagonist can take life force (Qi) from living creatures, turn into a ghost and possess them. A Story of Vengeance: Having made a deal with death, the girl must defeat the marauding army through stealth and combat. A Delicate Balance: Challenging situations call for clever solutions, will you go the stealthy route, possessing your foes and sneaking past problems, or will you go with brute force, and fight your way through the situation?
row.short_description: A paranormal stealth-action and tactics game about a young Korean girl who was killed in a military conflict and returned from the dead with the ability to turn into a ghost and possess living creatures to exact her revenge.
row.notes: This game is a work of fiction and should not be seen as realistic or historically accurate. Please treat this as an entertainment product. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed. Please make sure to seek proper guidance or counseling if any of the themes concern you.

row.name: Out Bike the Tsunami™
row.detailed_description: Out Bike the Tsunami is an endless runner game based on true story. Bike through a platformer stage with obstacles throw at you while avoiding getting caught by the tsunami. Use ← ↑ → ↓ keys to control Ian's movement. Good luck.
row.short_description: A giant tsunami is coming!!! Help Ian bike to his safety.

row.name: Space Tek
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord About the Game Hey, are you feeling the need to blow some spaceships up? Want to send your opponents back to the dark ages? Do you like the thrill, in a team or alone? SpaceTek is an exciting ship building and combat game inspired by Sci-Fi movies and series. The SpaceTek commanders mission will be to design and create a unique or inspired spaceship. Place turrets, Utilities, Shields and more on your ship to make yourself the most effective ship in the fleet. You will therefor need to destroy and gather enough Raw Metal components to buy new blocks ready to be used on your ship. Gamemodes Once you are ready to go, you will be able to choose from 2 gamemodes, whether that's team deathmatch or capture the ship is up to you. Team deathmatch game mode puts you head to head with another fleet of SpaceTek commanders, but be warned they could have defensive or weaponry blocks that could cause you serious damage. Your goal in team deathmatch is to destroy the enemies team relay station by doing so you stop there commanders from regenerating there ships. Capture the ship game mode will again put you head to head with enemy SpaceTek commanders but your task is to bring back enough disabled ships by tractoring them towards your relay station. Which ever fleet collects the most disabled ships wins the battle. Multiplayer Play alone in a artificial fleet, or team up with players in Online matches bringing all the deadly abilities with you to eliminate the enemy fleet Ship customisation By using your collected Raw Metal components, gather blocks to build a ship ready to face the enemy fleet. There are a range of blocks to choose from such as turrets, Shields, Grappling hooks, Shield plating, core hull blocks and more. Try combine different blocks to see how much you can devastate your enemies.
row.short_description: SPACE TEK, Command, Construct, Collect!Space Tek is an exciting free to play online starship combat game. Players build their dream ships out of a range of unique blocks, and tailor their ships. Then put the ships to the test alongside or against players and Ai in a multitude of gamemodes!

row.name: Last Blossom: Roleplaying tabletop based scene
row.detailed_description: Last Blossom it's a short game scene, based on one well-known tabletop roleplaying game. I tried to reproduce the game rules with some accuracy, so it contains, if I may say, only a few 'home rules'. So this scene may help to understand some of the basic rules of roleplaying tabletop games. If you are a lonely adventurer that standing on a crossroad with grey, boring and empty life on one way and creative, unbelievable and full of discoveries life of a roleplayer in another hand - i hope Last Blossom will help you to choose the right road. And if you will not be quite inspired about all of this - just be sure that real roleplaying games with the right people are way better, so please don't give up! This scene is pretty short, so if you don't want to have more spoilers - you may consider just to try it first. But if you need a features list, well... Features: Dice rolls - cruel but honest random and its deadly consequences! Tense conversation Turn-based battle 3 playable characters Different ways to achieve the goal Fantasy adventure atmosphere, made of Low poly, patchy animation, 8-bit sounds, and Unreal Engine 4 features I tried to put in this scene more or less full tutorial and detailed 'Help' section, so if you are a beginner in this kind of genre, or maybe you not quite often playing in videogames at all - you still have a chance to figure out how it works. If you will have some trouble in understanding of what's happening in the game, or what you need to do - i would be grateful if you let me know about you're problem. OGL notice: This game contains some of the Open Game Content that used under and in terms of Open Gaming License Version 1.0a.
row.short_description: The last Blossom it's a short game scene, based on tabletop roleplaying games. It presents some story, and it's up to you to choose how it will go. Dice rolls and their consequences, tough negotiations, turn-based combat, adventurous atmosphere, and, of course, some dancing lights!
row.notes: Verbal abuse Unrealistic Violence Unrealistic Blood Unrealistic Kills

row.name: Random Blacksmith Game
row.detailed_description: Jump into a fictionalized and dramatized medieval village as the village's blacksmith. Craft weapons to sell to adventurers, go into the caves to mine for metals, live through wars and much more in this wacky medieval adventure! Gameplay Tips The more weapons you produce, the more adventures can clear the mines of goblins Less goblins = more higher quality metals Gather weapons from fallen soldiers during wars to sell in your store Don't be scared of the goblins, be scared of going back to get your loot
row.short_description: Jump into a fictionalized and dramatized medieval village as the village's blacksmith.

row.name: Probability Race
row.detailed_description: Probability Race is a futuristic racing game. You must use logic, math, probability and luck to win the championship. Play a great variety of minigames and compete in turn based races every day. Unlock abilities and race your way to victory in this platform/stragegy/turnbased game.
row.short_description: Probability Race is a futuristic racing game. You must use logic, math, probability and luck to win the championship. Play a great variety of minigames and compete in turn based races every day. Unlock abilities and race your way to victory in this platform/stragegy/turnbased game.

row.name: Newtonian Horror
row.detailed_description: Newtonian Horror is an occult platformer where you can't move or shoot and the only weapon at your disposal is gravity. During the game, you play as Isaac Newton and try to overcome the Evil League who's trying to disprove your theories of gravity. Use your knowledge of gravity to manipulate your environment and save the world! IN A TIME BEFORE GRAVITY The year is 1678, and Isaac Newton hasn't made his groundbreaking discovery about gravity yet. As a result, the world does not yet have gravity. In Newtonian Horror, you will find yourself in a world in disarray, a world where everything floats and chaos reigns. However, you finally have the power to change this. As Newton, you finally begin to see the inner workings of gravity! And with this understanding, you can manipulate gravity fields around you and bend the world to your will. However, the Evil League is not too happy with your discoveries. The Evil League is a cult that worships the god of ignorance, Koalemos. They will do everything in their power in order to stop you from sharing your discovery of gravity with the rest of the world. It is up to you to fight them with your newfound powers. USE GRAVITY AS A WEAPON In Newtonian Horror, you live in a world before gravity! You, Isaac Newton, are the only person who is aware of this, and you use your knowledge to overcome your obstacles. During the game, you only have two powers at your disposal: Gravity and Anti-Gravity! Shoot your gravity magic at objects to create gravity wells to pull or push objects around you. Move around by pulling or pushing yourself and throw your enemies into the deadly weapons lying around. Be careful, you can just as easily harm yourself! Gravity is a cruel mistress... A fast-paced physics-based platformer Cute pixel-art graphics Over 20 levels Original soundtrack And it's free-to-play!
row.short_description: Step into the boots of Isaac Newton, in a world before gravity was invented. Newtonian Horror is an occult platformer where you can't move or shoot and the only weapon at your disposal is gravity. Use your exceptional knowledge as Newton to manipulate gravity and defeat your enemies!
row.notes: This game has some cartoon violence and gore at some levels.

row.name: Spaceship - Visual Effect Graph Demo
row.detailed_description: Spaceship is a short technical demo showcasing high-end visual effects of the Unity game engine. You will play a 5-minute long first-person narrative sequence: While escaping an alien attack, your spaceship has warped into uncertain space and you need to find an escape route, before your pursuers catch up with you. Roaming into the spaceship, and Interacting with holographic terminals maps, you need to find a way to land into safe space... or is it already too late? You can run the demo using different graphics quality levels and test some graphics features of Unity High Definition Render Pipeline. Also, we provide a benchmark mode that runs a simulation of the demo and reports simple results. If you are interested on how the project was made, you can also download the full Unity project to learn, mod, reuse, or explore the content. It is available as open-source directly on GitHub.
row.short_description: Spaceship is a small-scale technical demo showcasing high-end rendering of the Unity Game Engine. It presents a 5 minute long sequence of narrative first-person game play, You can also download the open-source project and open it using Unity Editor to learn how it was made.

row.name: Paint By Numbers
row.detailed_description: The team of artists has just received an invitation to the Intergalactic Painting Tournament! Will they disgrace their planet or return home to adoring fans as champions? Choose from 1000+ pictures and PAINT BY NUMBERS to bring them to life! Colorful pixel art adventures are coming! Beautiful pixel artworks on exotic locations Handy mini-map Filler, Blockbuster, and Rainbow Crayon useful tools Smart alphanumeric colors numeration Smooth animations and beautiful special effects Thematic musical accompaniment Lifelike pictures after painting
row.short_description: The team of artists has just received an invitation to the Intergalactic Painting Tournament! Choose from 1000+ artworks and PAINT BY NUMBERS to bring them to life! Colorful pixel art adventures are coming!

row.name: Roots of Tomorrow
row.detailed_description: Roots of Tomorrow, your life on a sustainable farm Roots of Tomorrow is a strategy and management turn-based game made to better understand agroecology (sustainable agriculture). Play as one of four characters and start your farming career in France! Your mission: to achieve the agroecological transition of your farm within 10 years! You can take many paths to reach this objective, all will depend on the choices YOU make. Welcome to your farm! Brittany (Northwest of France) . Breed pigs and grow multiple crops Grand Est (Northeast of France) . Breed cattle and grow multiple crops Provence (Southeast of France) : Breed sheep and grow multiple crops More farms to be added soon! Manage a team! As the farm's head manager, you're in charge of affecting various tasks to your employees! There's loads to do: sowing seedlings, feeding your animals, cleaning, fertilizing, and even entertaining tourists! Careful not to overwork them though, or your farm's social score may suffer... Unlock sustainable farming techniques! Research is an essential part of sustainable agriculture! Unlock direct seeding, hedges to preserve biodiversity, energy autonomy, precision agriculture, and many more sustainable farming practices! Keep an eye on your farm's scores! To achieve a truly sustainable farm, you'll need to balance your economic, environmental, and social scores. They are affected by every decision you make on your farm so think twice before using synthetic fertilizer or going into too much debt!
row.short_description: Roots of Tomorrow is a free-to-play sustainable farming manager/simulator. Expand your farm, take care of your animals, upgrade your buildings, invest in research, and explore the solutions offered by agroecology!

row.name: Fruit Hunter
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Hunt for fruit with your bow and magic-wand-with-fork. Fruit will try and run away but you need to be quick enough to capture them. Collect enough fruit to fill your bowl and progress to the next mission. Environments Experience the 4 different regions, dark forest, plains, hot desert and rocky volcano. Traverse these landscapes in order to find the fruits that are hiding. Be cautious of the terrain as the different regions each have their own difficulties. Overcome your obstacles and ultimately fill all of your fruit bowls.
row.short_description: Hungry for some fruit! Jump into missions and hunt for fruits running for their lives. Use your trusty bow and magic-wand-with-fork and capture them before they have the chance to escape. Travel to different environments and discover what fruit that resides in these unfamiliar and rough landscapes.

row.name: Ruka
row.detailed_description: Play as a clumsy girl looking to meet up with her Grandfather. Features Play as clumsy Ruka Short adventure Can't move for shungite Dodge monsters Push boxes around Traverse the manor efficiently Inspirations Inspired by Helltaker
row.short_description: Ruka is a cartoon puzzle game where you play as a clumsy girl who is quite oblivious to the outside world. Maneuver through your Grandfather's manor and survive the mysteries there and find him. But be warned, not everything is as it seems!

row.name: Zombie Survival online
row.detailed_description: ZS Online is a top-down 2D shooting multiplayer game that you can enjoy in less than 10 to 16 minutes. Pick up the materials during the day, and make the weapons and items you want! At night, the view becomes narrow and zombies come out. The number of zombies increases every day, and poisonous gases hit the city. Players can pick up materials scattered across various buildings in the city. You can harvest trees and fruits. The map shows the position of the other player, and if you enter the house, you will not be able to see the opponent. Hunger decreases, and the faster you move, the faster you decrease. When hunger reaches zero, your stamina decreases, and you can eat food to make up for it. You can combine the ingredients to make weapons, such as knives and guns, or throw tools, armor, and food. It gets dark at night, and the view is limited, and zombies come out. You will also lose sight of other players on the map. As the days go by, the number of zombies increases, and poison gas hits the city. If there is only one player left on the map, you will win. Choose a character with multiple abilities and play it. You can also play by yourself without the Internet. In this case, zombies come out during the day, and more. Also, poison gas does not hit the city and scores points.
row.short_description: ZS Online is a top-down 2D shooting multiplayer game that you can enjoy in 10 to 16 minutes. Pick up items, combine them, and survive the longest among other players in a large city where zombies appear at night! As the days go by, the sort of zombies increases, and poisonous gas hits the city...

row.name: SCORCH
row.detailed_description: What is SCORCH? SCORCH takes inspiration from the noir films of the 40s and 50s. Make your way through a black and white world, using the shadows to hide and take out the numerous thugs stalking the harbor around your home. Seek out the truth of their appearance in this stealth FPS shooter. You are Morgan Hand... Morgan Hand never thought about leaving the life of a hitman...until they met Mona. For the first time, they felt as though they could break away from that old life and start anew, but that involved cutting ties with the Giudice crime family. Now, it seems that an entire squad of assassins is after this retired gun. If Morgan wants to be free with Mona, they’re gonna have to do one last job. Shadows and Lights In the silent streets of this night-wrapped 1940’s city, it’s important to know how to take advantage of your surroundings. Use the shadows to hide, but be wary, as any number of hired guns could be lying in wait for you to walk into their trap. Counter this advantage by shining a light on the area, be it a flashlight or a muzzle flash. Search the docks for the leaders of this little hit, and show them why you don’t mess with Morgan Hand. Plus, who knows? Maybe they hold some answers to the true nature of this operation… About SCORCH - Stealth focused combat - Collect evidence through Objectives - Monochromatic art style - Noir themes - Original soundtrack - Speedrunable About Accidentally Games Accidentally Games is a small dev team of undergraduate game development students. This game was made remotely while in our final semester, and we are greatly excited to bring it to Steam. Through many challenges, we are excited to bring our passion to you through this game. Dave Crandall was a talented musician, sound engineer, and voice actor, as well as a wonderful friend. Without him, SCORCH would not have succeeded. R.I.P. Dave, you will be missed.
row.short_description: SCORCH is a noir-inspired stealth, first-person shooter. Takedown thugs as you try to break away from your former life. Stalk the shadows, gather evidence, and get out of town. SCORCH is first and foremost a stealth game before it is a shooter.
row.notes: The game contains blood effects (pixelated and cartoony)

row.name: Squeaky Clean
row.detailed_description: It's 2016, a string of murders across the United States has suddenly revived an old urban legend known as the 'Shower Slasher' a mysterious figured associated with similar murders dating back generations. Keep your ears open as you try to enjoy your otherwise relaxing shower and try to ignore the sensation you have that days seem to be repeating, that figures are darting around in your peripheral, and that unshakable feeling that you are being watched. Ignore it. Respond to your friends texts, let them know that nothing is wrong. Envelope yourself in Steam and the tunes playing in your head. Make yourself Squeaky Clean. Squeaky Clean is a psychological horror game set entirely in the shower. Manage your cleanliness while strange ghost-like beings haunt you. Simple controls and quick but challenging levels ensure that Squeaky Clean can be played and feared by everyone Experience the horror of your average shower! Absorb hot shower tunes by Hoovobot Watch the fate of five very clean shower-folk Endure the challenge of survival! Squeaky Clean is best enjoyed in a dark room with headphones and includes many jump scares, flashing lights, adult language, and occasional intense scenes.
row.short_description: Psychological horror set in your favorite place: a nice hot shower.
row.notes: Contains swearing Contains blood Contains adult themes

row.name: The night of fire stealing 2/盗火之夜2
row.detailed_description: The night of fire stealing 2 This game is the second work of The night of fire stealing series. This is a Retro RPG game. No maps, no directions. It tells the story of the encounter between the administrator and the old ones in the eastern TianTang City. plot The plot of this work is inherited from the previous work. In 2019, the player will play the protagonist Yan Yue and witness the contradiction between the administrator and the old gods from his perspective. This supposed peaceful modern city is facing a huge crisis Together with the administrator to solve these crises, with the old ones of the universe to make an end. game playing and operation The round operation of 4-person team is adopted. By clicking on the ground with the mouse, the movement power is consumed to move in the maze. One attack or one use of props will consume all the movement power. The props of skills and equipment are released by using the specified keys on the keyboard underground labyrinth In the underground maze, you can't save outside the designated save point. If all the members of the team are killed, you will be judged dead. You can only read the previous archive and start over again. With the progress of the game, you can unlock more maps and more enemies About some sensitive content The game may contain some sensitive content, including minor pornography and violence. If you don't like the content, please don't buy the game
row.short_description: It's a difficult retro RPG game. No maps, no directions. Explore the dungeons as a team of four, moving freely through the maze and deftly dealing with various enemies. Fight the old gods in the eastern Tiantang city .
row.notes: This game contains minor pornographic or violent content. However, considering the nature of the game, this game is suitable for normal players over 18 years old. The game does not include sexual abuse / involuntary sex, drug / alcohol abuse or self harm.

row.name: MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE
row.detailed_description: Season 14 Begins! Season 14 sees the highly anticipated arrival of Armored All Might, the ‘Symbol of Peace’ clad in a jet-black robotic suit! This character utilizes a Support Item that mimics the Quirks of Class 1-A at U.A. High School to confuse opponents while fighting! Additionally, this season will be continuously adding new costumes not seen elsewhere, along with illustrations featuring characters in those costumes. Don't miss out on getting them! Leap into the fray with your fellow heroes...and villains! Use communication, tactics, and synergize Quirks with your team of 3 to be the last ones standing in this 24-player Battle Royale! Pick up your favorite characters from a quirky roster divided into 5 archetypes: Strike, Assault, Rapid, Technical, and Support. The strengths of each character are completely different depending on their unique Quirk. Find items, interact with civilians, and defeat opponents to improve your abilities and get the upper hand over other teams! Unlock new characters and customization options by gaining experience and completing missions. Participate in seasonal events and try your luck with tickets to glam up with exclusive items! The game will be updated each season to include new elements, focusing on new characters and costumes! Jump in and get a hold of the rapidly changing battle conditions! *This game is meant to be played online only. It cannot be played in offline mode. *An internet connection is required to play this game. *The service and its contents are subject to change or end without prior notice.
row.short_description: Pick your favorite character, team up and fight to be the last ones standing in the new 24-player Battle Royale free to play game 'MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE'!

row.name: Bite At The Museum
row.detailed_description: One night, at Just Another Museum, Tim The Time Machine decides he has had enough. After years of being put on display without his own exhibit, he figures it’s about time to get the recognition he deserves. He needs to destroy all the other exhibits to finally get his chance in the spotlight. But how exactly? Well, by kidnap- I mean recruiting a 67 million-year-old friend of course! Play as Tony, the Tyrannosaurus Rex! Tony is lovable, hungry, cute, and eager to watch everything crash and burn. Bust and break your way through three fun-filled exhibits to score points, impress Tim, and make it back home! Sweep the competition with your tail swipe, chew up your enemies, and destroy priceless artifacts to show them whose boss! Take a BITE out of the competition today! This game was made by a group of students in the EAE program at the University of Utah as our capstone project. We just wanted to sincerely thank you for checking us out and we hope you have a dino-mite time playing!
row.short_description: Play as Tony the baby Tyrannosaurus and rex shop like never before. Tricera-top the scoreboard as you styrac up dino-mite combos! Veloci-rip through 3 unique exhibits! Stego around and ptero down all sorts of displays and cause a giganto mess! Ankylosaurus!

row.name: School For The Friendless
row.detailed_description: When Harold (or whatever you decide to name him) is sent to a college for people that have no friends, he has no idea what to expect. Not long after arriving, he ends up finding out that the school pairs its students together and when they're together, they're assigned the same room. However, these students don't have to be the same gender and he is high chance of sharing his room with a girl. At this school, he meets three girls that won't leave him alone. The first one we have is Anima, who likes to cause trouble for others. She's always making things hard on her teachers and even her friends have trouble getting her to behave herself. Next is the weird and mysterious, Scout, who happens to be the most innocent and childlike of the three. She's an obsession with the supernatural and an endless appetite. Finally, there's Vivian, the annoying pervert who doesn't really care who is around when she's being inappropriate. Despite her behavior, she does have a bit of a mature side, which usually surprises others. All students must take a survey and then their actions will be observed throughout the day. The choices you make will determine who your partner is. Harold may end up with one of the three girls or with someone else entirely. Since there are three girls, there are three main routes, each with three endings. Whether Harold remains as just friends with these girls or something more depends on the choices he makes. Each of the routes can be completed within an hour. With these three girls, Harold will got caught up in all kinds of messes, learning more about them as time goes by. School For The Friendless is a comedic visual novel with multiple endings depending on how you choose to develop Harold's relationships with the girls.
row.short_description: Harold is sent to a school for people with no friends. The teachers observe and then pair them up, making them roommates. What will happen when Harold ends up sharing a room with a girl?
row.notes: This visual novel contains sexual humor. While there is no nudity or sexual acts shown, some minor things are mentioned to be happening off screen. No sexual content is shown to the player, but inappropriate things are mentioned multiple times throughout the story. Some of the bad endings contain character deaths, one of which being through suicide.

row.name: Codename Prodigy
row.detailed_description: Join Discord To Help In Early Access About the Game About Codename Prodigy Codename Prodigy (CNP) is a mix of traditional and platform fighting games. The game is focused on using the stage against your opponent with stage hazards, health-stealing floors, and destructible walls. SPECIAL STAGES Head into an all-out brawl-out with a DIVERSE SET OF STAGES WITH UNIQUE CHARACTERISTICS! Remember that most of these stages damage you by just being on the ground too!! It's almost like the stages are also characters... DIVERSE CAST OF CHARACTERS Immerse yourself and use your playstyle in an increasing cast of characters each of who utilize their vastly DIFFERENT GAMEPLAY through their talents to fight PREPARE YOURSELF WITH TUTORIAL MODE Learn the ropes and the intricacies of Codename Prodigy's combos, mechanics, and techniques in its EASY-TO-FOLLOW TUTORIALS! Characters Mae's your basic character that's made to introduce players to the game. However she is easy to learn, she can even do better when her Water Specials are mastered Isaac's the perfect zoner, he can alternate between 2 states that also change how his projectiles work. In his normal state his projectile does more damage but less knockback the more it travels, and an Overdrive state where it does the opposite and gives Isaac faster melee moves at the expense of the ground draining his HP faster Phoebe's gameplay functions like a double edged sword. Using her special she takes more damage, and accumulates that damage in order to release it in her next attack. On the otherhand, should the opponent land their strike first Phoebe also takes some of that accumulated damage Kylian plays around his daggers that makes the enemy take more damage from the ground the more daggers land on them. The daggers could be stacked up to 3 times, but they eventually all go away after a bit of time Juliana's passive abilities are all about movement. They allow her to have less cooldown on her dodges, and it allows her to also dodge into a wall in order to bounce back up in the air without going into hitstun
row.short_description: A Couch-Play Platform fighter with Traditional fighting game aspects that focuses on using your stage against your opponent, with each character taking advantage of the stages in unique and different ways

row.name: Maroon
row.detailed_description: Maroon is an interactive virtual STEM laboratory and experimentation environment that allows you to explore various experiments and phenomena in an immersive and engaging way. The main laboratory room consists of different experiment stations and acts as a three-dimensional menu. Choose any experiment to start. Currently, Maroon supports experiments from the fields of electromagnetism, electrostatics, oscillation, waves, analytical chemistry, and algorithms. Experiments Among others, you can try out the following experiments from the fields of physics, chemistry, and computer science: Coulomb's Law Falling Coil (Electromagnetism) Faraday's Law Huygen's Principle Point Wave Pendulum Van de Graaff Balloon Van de Graaff Generator Optics 3D Motion Cathode Ray Tube Viscosimeter Planetary System Titration Catalyst Sorting Algorithms State Machines Pathfinding Algorithms Minimum Spanning Tree Perlin Noise Virtual Reality Maroon is also available for VR. Choose an experiment from the vending machine and you are ready to start exploring! Currently, six of the experiments are supported in Virtual Reality.
row.short_description: Maroon is an immersive learning experience supporting more than 20 experiments from the fields of physics, chemistry, and computer science. Enter the virtual laboratory to try out all kinds of interactive simulations.

row.name: Dawn of Corruption
row.detailed_description: A NSFW fantasy RPG about exploring a mysterious world and the substance that turns men into massive, monstrous beasts.
row.short_description: Dawn of Corruption is a Dark Fantasy NSFW RPG. Warning, this game is nsfw 18+ only. It features male gay characters and fetishes such as: Muscle Growth, Macro, Hyper, Goo, Transformation, Corruption What will you grow into? Will corruption seep into your being?
row.notes: Dawn of Corruption contains frequent depictions of sex acts including but not limited to fetish content, nudity, huge insertions, vore, bodily fluids, macro, hyper, goo, transformation, multi-limbs and more. The narrative includes themes of a sexual nature including exploration of inner desires, mind control. Enemies can dominate the player sexually on some context but the player always have an opportunity to escape before it reaches that point. The game contains descriptions of violence through its combat mechanics and plot. Some scenes describe wounds with visual details.

row.name: Unforgettable You
row.detailed_description: More Games About the Game Unforgettable You is a heartfelt platformer that weaves a tender story about love, loss, and reflection. Through the voice of a man reminiscing about his past, players are taken on a journey through 21 beautifully designed levels that echo the highs and lows of his relationship. The game blends light puzzle elements with skill-based platforming, creating a mellow yet engaging experience. Immerse yourself in its captivating silhouette art style, reminiscent of Limbo , as you explore environments that mirror the emotions of the story. Each chapter introduces new mechanics to keep the gameplay fresh, while the narrated voice-over (with optional subtitles) provides a poignant and personal touch to the unfolding narrative. Whether you’re looking for a thought-provoking journey or a relaxing playthrough, Unforgettable You offers an emotional experience that will leave a lasting impression. Best of all, the game is completely free to play, so you can dive into this introspective adventure at no cost. Features : 21 distinct levels, each with unique elements. A stunning silhouette art style. Fully voiced narration with subtitles. Free to play! Discover a platformer that’s more than just a game – it’s a reflection on love, life, and the moments that stay with us forever. Play now and experience the unforgettable!
row.short_description: Unforgettable You is a contemplating platformer game about love.

row.name: WORLD EATER
row.detailed_description: DESTRUCTION IS UPON US WORLD EATER  is a bossfight game about an underpaid astronaut fighting a giant worm in space. You are a regular crystal mining employee for the company , who has tasked you with a seamingly easy endeavor. One of their worms has discovered a magical resource called space dust , which has some interesting side effects.  Set out on a mission that is most definitely not stated in your contract and defeat the world eating worm! Show em' how it's done. Run, fly, dodge and smack your way through this epic space bossfight against the colossal, solar system eating worm! FEATURES Enjoy the vast, beautiful space environments Run, fly and dodge on interesting and ever-changing planets Fight your way through several environments while the WORLD EATER  tries to stop you WHAT'S NEXT? We are a small team of 4 developers who have been working at improving the current state of the game. We are planning on creating a lot more content with new and interesting mechanics and environments. We hope you join us in our journey in making our student project a full-fledged game!
row.short_description: WORLD EATER is a bossfight game about an underpaid astronaut fighting a giant worm in space. Fight your way through varying planets and defeat the colossal worm!

row.name: ENEMIES
row.detailed_description: Join our discord Interested in keeping up to date on development and even giving feedback? Join us at our Discord server! About the Game Set in a retro-new-age video game development corporation focused on bringing games to the next level with immersion technology, till things start to go wrong as you discover everything is not as it seems. Traversing the company building looking for answers and fighting bad guys in Lollygag Labs newest shooter: ENEMIES as you unravel the secrets and discover the story behind it all. (and lollygag along the way) Gameplay: You start on a trip to an imaginative video game company: Lollygag Labs to try out their new VR like video game experience known as immersion. Exploring the building in a first-person shooter style, going through immersion pods, picking up boxes, finding key cards, killing enemies, meeting FRED and discovering a lost love ENEMIES is an indie game made by Ian Fitzsimmons's solo company: Lollygag Labs and hopes to bring a compelling story and high-tier gameplay in a world of their own creation Trying to take inspiration from some classic titles we hope to bring a truly memorable experience and hope we can hit that goal Keep up to date on the development of ENEMIES on our Discord server and give feedback on your thoughts and ideas for ENEMIES, we'd love to hear them!
row.short_description: Venturing into the exciting work of Lollygag Labs, a game developing corporation looking to breach the barriers of what can be achieved with gaming, then things take a dark turn...get ready to jump into the crazy world of ENEMIES!

row.name: DataJack
row.detailed_description: DataJack is a 2D isometric stealth action shooter originally released in 2013. In the not-too-distant future, governments have dissolved and powerful mega-corporations wage covert wars for territory and the control of information. As a freelance mercenary, you will conduct sabotage, assassinations, espionage and ambushes on their behalf to earn a living. 30+ nonlinear stealth action missions Do missions on behalf of three separate factions to earn credits. Your reputation will grow from being a simple goon for hire knocking off fast food restaurants, to a highly-paid corporate assassin infiltrating high-security laboratories and office buildings. Open-ended gameplay Before you go weapons hot, consider scouting the location for cameras, gun turrets, guard patrols, and computers of interest. Plan your approach. Hack the locked doors. Hack the network and steal some valuable data and disable the cameras. Sneak up behind the guard and take them out before they can alert the others. Sabotage the alarm system. Trigger your remote charge to explode the generator for an instant lights-out, or cover your tracks with smoke grenades. A successful mission combines careful planning with skilled improvisation when things go wrong. Of course, it may be best to take a loud approach and dominate the enemy with overwhelming firepower before they have a chance to react. Destructible terrain All walls and obstacles are fully destructible, if you remembered to bring the heavy ordinance. You can open new entrances, or set up emergency exits. Just watch out if the robot chasing you is armed with a rocket launcher! 29+ weapons From submachine guns to shotguns, sniper rifles to rocket launchers, everything you need to conduct urban wetworks can be found at the local black market arms trade. Choose from an array of primary and secondary weapons and then fine-tune their stats for stealth, accuracy, or stopping power by purchasing unique weapon modifications. Round out your kit with EMP grenades, field health kits, IR sensing goggles, ninja equipment, and various other military surplus. Cybernetic upgrade system Use your credits to upgrade your arms, legs, eyes, and torso for bonuses to combat, speed, and stealth. Pay the street doc to heal your numerous wounds between missions. With augmented eyes, you can see laser tripwires before setting them off, while augmented legs may give you the drop on your unsuspecting enemy.
row.short_description: Take contracts from sinister megacorporations in this isometric stealth action shooter with RPG elements. Choose your approach: hack defenses, take down the guards, or blow a new entrance with explosives. Use your credits to buy weapons, cyberlimbs, hack software, and ninja gear.
row.reviews: “I like games where you get to be a hacker and snag cash by blowing up the system.” Rock Paper Shotgun “DataJack Is Your Free, Isometric Cyberpunk PC Game For Today” Kotaku
row.notes: The game involves shooting people, with visible blood splatter. Additionally, people can explode into bloody chunks that go flying.

row.name: World Senate
row.detailed_description: World senate game is an online multiplayer game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a country, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, fight in wars, be a country president, join the world senate and be a world senator or representative, vote world issues and you can do many other activities. Upon joining world senate game a citizen is assigned to a virtual country citizenship based on they're choice when joined the game. Each of these countries are named after an actual country in the real world. World Senate Game tends to be a combined version of the real world with the fun of a game where citizens can play the game and also follow the footsteps of world politics where anyone can be a country senator or country president and they are chosen by direct vote from other citizens. Training, working, fighting in wars, special agent fights and taking part in races is done on a daily basis and you decide the time you want to invest in it. Be the change you wanna see. The world needs YOU!
row.short_description: World senate is an online browser game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a country, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, be a country president, world senator or representative, vote world issues and you can do many other activities.

row.name: WillWalker
row.detailed_description: WillWalker is a shooter game set in a cyberpunk universe, where time is your life and you have to kill enemies in order to advance in the game and achieve the objectives. Dive into more than 20 challenging missions which take you through the city and its surroundings, annihilating rival mobs and those who don't want you to succeed. Kill all the enemies, avenge the death of your family and become the next Capo of the city by conquering all of its areas. The time is gold. Do not waste it. MAIN FEATURES Discover and play with 4 unique characters. Upgrade each character to unlock special attacks and weapon upgrades. Kill your enemies and avenge the death of your family. Face the police and gangs to become the new boss of the city. Try to get the best time in each level to get better rewards.
row.short_description: WillWalker is a frenetic shooter set in a cyberpunk metropolis. Fight to overthrow crime by mastering the mysteries of time.
row.notes: Game contains violence and representations of alcohol and tobacco.

row.name: You Are Kaiju
row.detailed_description: Welcome to You are Kaiju. This game involves you the player rampaging through cities and causing chaos. Breath fire and fire plasma beams from your hands. Try to get the highest score through the levels. The mechanics in this game are as follows: The Player Can: Breath Fire, Fire Plasma beams from both hands, pickup cars and bash them against buildings. There are cars that drive around, citizens that will walk around, and tanks that will try to lower the players score.
row.short_description: Welcome to You are Kaiju. A rampage vr game where you the player will destroy cities to get a good score. Be careful though. There are tanks that will try to lower your score. Have fun by breathing fire and firing plasma beams from your hands.

row.name: Valley of Dragons
row.detailed_description: Love dragons? Want to raise a dragon of your own? Valley of Dragons is a VR game where you raise up your own personal dragon from an egg to an adult through feeding, petting, and playing with your dragon. Along the way, be prepared to teach it how to hunt, fly, and defend itself!
row.short_description: In Valley of Dragons, be prepared to raise and care for your own personal dragon!

row.name: Chronicles of Tal'Dun: The Remainder - Act 1
row.detailed_description: Expanded Edition Released The full game is available on its own store page. The Expanded Edition with new content is available! About the Game You wake in a collapsing tower with no memory. The only other person here—a silver-tongued mage named Ilar—claims to be saving your life through a desperate ritual. Yet, their story keeps changing and you keep dying. This is Chronicles of Taldun: the Remainder, a dark fantasy visual novel where death is not the end—it's how you learn the truth. Play as Vyn, a High Magus trapped with Ilar in a tower that's tearing itself apart. Each death reveals another fragment of memory, another piece of the mystery. Were you colleagues? Lovers? Enemies? The deeper you dig, the less certain you become, and the more you realize Ilar may not be trying to save you at all. Read between the lines. Explore for clues. Use hands-on deduction to break the vicious circle and set them both free. What Awaits You: 172,000 words of bittersweet psychological horror (8-40 hours) Over 500 choices , some more regrettable than others. 50+ false endings and 3 true endings —dying teaches you how to live Multiple romance paths with a nonbinary love interest (optional, fully avoidable) Death-loop narrative structure where every playthrough reveals new layers RPGFan Games of the Year 2022 - Editor's Choice Award 96%+ Positive user reviews 'Bittersweet, hopeful, and utterly poignant... I was violently sobbing near the end.' - Player Review 'A breathtaking narrative that explores memory, identity, and love across lifetimes.' - Player Review Also Featuring: A magnificent cat who cares not if you live or die An adorable eel friend Death. Lots of it. An angry potato For fans of The House in Fata Morgana, Disco Elysium, Umineko When They Cry, and literary dark fantasy by Susanna Clarke and Madeline Miller. Return to this universe 9,000 turns earlier in Chronicles of Taldun: The Longing—Coming 2026
row.short_description: A dark fantasy tale where death is not the end but the path to the truth. Two magi trapped in a collapsing tower must unravel a deadly mystery. Each death reveals another piece of the puzzle that is their shared past and forbidden love. For fans of House in Fata Morgana and literary dark fantasy.
row.reviews: “Square Weasel Studios has delivered an understated hit of an interactive visual novel, and I highly recommend it for people interested in that style of gaming experience.” 9.5/10 – Chalgyr's Game Room “A gorgeously illustrated choose-your-own-adventure game that is filled with enigmatic characters and an alluring storyline that will have you just as wrapped in its mysteries as the protagonist is.” 8/10 – Gaming Cypher “The game’s poignant storytelling experience stays with you once you reach its tender true ending. This VN is more than worth it, given the thoughtful messages and emotions it conveys.” GOTY – RPG Fan
row.notes: The game includes descriptions of sexual themes, violence, blood, physical and mental abuse, self harm, death, and suicide. Characters are going through emotional struggle and are dealing with a life threatening situation.

row.name: Vanaris Tactics - Prologue
row.detailed_description: The Prologue of Vanaris Tactics is the beginning chapter to the upcoming narrative tactical RPG game that tells a story about refugees fleeing their occupied motherland. Experience the first three battles as you lead a group of refugees looking for freedom outside the walls of Vanaris, unite your people and use tactical prowess to escape your oppressors. Vanaris Tactics tells the story of Morgana in her struggle to find freedom outside the walls of Vanaris. Accompanied by her brother Nigel and nephew Adrien, they must flee their motherland, a place they once called home. Discover the vast realm of Vanaris and meet new people on the same path, as they must leave everything behind to escape their oppressors and find peace. Play the first three battles and experience what the world of Vanaris Tactics can offer. Vanaris Tactics implements a combat initiative unit turn system inspired by the greatest fantasy tactics RPGs of all time. Unite a band of unique characters with their own strengths, skills, and stories. Gain new abilities and increase your range of options to deal with new challenges. Different combinations of weapons and accessories and see a unit’s playstyle change drastically. Travel the land of Vanaris to discover powerful treasures and hear untold stories. However, keep your guard up as danger lurks in every corner. A rich blend of tactics and fantasy RPG, Vanaris Tactics implements an intuitive turn-based combat system inspired by the golden age of turn-based tactics games. Strategically plan your movement to attack enemies, and be aware of their counterattacks. Strike your foes from afar or jump into the fray; every decision will prove crucial in combat. Utilize various skills and status effects to aid your allies and cripple your enemies.
row.short_description: Play the Prologue chapter of Vanaris Tactics. Lead a group of refugees looking for freedom outside the walls of Vanaris, and experience the first three battles and story of Vanaris Tactics.

row.name: MR 333
row.detailed_description: When the ritual begins it is feeding time. From what can be gathered the disturbed creature lurking in the deep caves must be fed the strange orb-shaped beings for substance or he will consume the body. A sacrifice to pay for the ritual of leaving the secret sanctuary. One of the many strange creatures found in these labs, but by far one of the most terrifying to be reported will hunt you until the very end. Leave the blue colored beings in the altar room where the ritual began. Four should sustain his hunger and reverse his summoning. After you may finish the ritual with the teleporter device located in the large, tile room. Remember: Find the strange alien creatures known as the orbs. Bring them to where the ritual began. When the four are left leave through the portal. Thank you for playing and I hope you enjoy my first published project. -With much appreciation, The Bry Guy.
row.short_description: When the ritual begins it is feeding time. Find his substance or he will consume your body.

row.name: Secrets Of Soil
row.detailed_description: Henry Driver's new interactive journey, Secrets of Soil, was inspired by his family's attempts to make their farming practices carbon negative. He presents a visually striking view of the world beneath our feet and explores his thoughts around how it would be possible to better care for and preserve it. Secrets of Soil is an artistic experience set in a reimagining of the cosmic world beneath our feet. Explore the microscopic landscape to understand the many citizens of the soil and the essential roles they play in this diverse ecosystem. Witness how bacteria and plants speak to each other. Glide through vast fungal webs. Create earthworm burrows. Or simply relax and linger in dazzling soilscapes and explore this unseen world. Unearth the secret of how this hidden universe could help save us from climate disaster. Navigate your way through vibrant landscapes and explore the microbiology of the soil and incredible creatures who live there. Secrets of Soil is an artist’s vision centred around bringing awareness to the change that we can all be a part of when thinking about the world we live in. The project received support from leading Plant Science and Microbiology Researchers at the John Innes Centre, UK. Secrets of Soil is freely available on Steam as a short interactive experience, with a free 360-degree video version also available here: New Creatives is supported by Arts Council England and BBC Arts. Henry Driver - Design, Coding, Sound Collusion - Production Partner Producers - Rachel Drury & Rich Hall John Innes Centre - Research Support Lynsey Murrell - Narration Sam Snape - Script Editor Peter Richardson - Exec Producer Joseph Amoah - Exec Producer for BBC R&D Jo Nolan - Programme Producer New Creatives Screen South
row.short_description: Secrets of Soil is an interactive journey that explores the hidden world of soil and its role in combating climate change. Your journey will take you to a microscopic world, witnessing the essential life forms that live there.
row.reviews: “hypnotic pleasure…Driver turns this subterranean odyssey into something truly fantastical: colonies of swarming bacteria and glowing fungi are made to look like alien worlds, with the sort of palette you’d normally associate with games from Mizuguchi and Minter.” Edge “A spectacular underground cosmos. It’s everything I wish my educational software at school could have been.” Vice “Dazzling use of light and colour…If you’ve ever enjoyed an abstract walking sim (or an abstract expressionist painting, for that matter), you’ll find a lot to love in Secrets of Soil.” Gamers With Glasses

row.name: Chair Simulator
row.detailed_description: Chair simulator is an exciting single player adventure for PC (Windows and MacOS) that puts the player right into the sitting seat. Featuring hundreds of chairs, multiple endings, and a balance between relaxing chair collection and challenging sitting-posture gameplay. Chair Simulator has all your favorite chairs, from Eames, Saarinen, Starcke, Bertoli, Corbusier, Thonet, Emeco, Panton, Jensen, Breuer, Van Der Rohe and more! Buy chairs. Sit down. Accumulate Sit Points through the all-new Sit Point System. Spend your Sit Points on new chairs! The possibilities are endless. But be careful: sitting still for too long can get uncomfortable fast, and this leads to numbness, hemorrhoids, muscle atrophy, and ultimately permadeath. Chair Simulator is the Dark Souls of sitting simulators. Play as one of 14 unique characters, whom you may recognize from real life. Chair Simulator features pro sitters including MrBeast, Dillon Francis, Corinna Kopf, Nadeshot, JustMaiko, Evan Palmblad, Neeko, Muselk, Lazarbeam, Faze Kay, Faze Jarvis, 24kgoldn, Muselk, Cheetles, and Bingo Bob. Chair Simulator takes place over TWO exciting locations: your living room, and a sprawling blue and yellow chair store. Progress through an extensive unlock tree to attain ever more luxurious designer chairs. At the end of the day we all need to sit: chair simulator lets you sit in style.
row.short_description: Buy chairs. Sit down. Accumulate Sit Points through the all-new Sit Point System. Spend your Sit Points on new chairs! The possibilities are endless. Chair Simulator has all your favorite chairs, from Eames, Starcke, Bertoli, Corbusier, Thonet, Emeco, Panton, Jensen, Breuer, Van Der Rohe and more!

row.name: The Genesis Project
row.detailed_description: Sburb, But Real The Genesis Project is the Homestuck fandom's attempt at recreating SBURB, the legendary world-ending game from the webcomic Homestuck. Build your way up through each gate and defeat unique enemies, bosses, and stairs. Play In Co-op Play a no-canon solo session, or create lobbies and play with your friends to wreak havoc upon the universe! Create New Items Use the revolutionary tag-based Alchemy system to combine absolutely any two items together... as long as you have the grist! More to Come! Join The Genesis Project Discord server, see what we're working on next, and talk to the devs directly! Your suggestions and help are always invaluable. Totally Free, Completely Non-profit Homestuck, SBURB, and many other concepts in this game are the intellectual property of Andrew Hussie, writer of Homestuck. This game is merely a labor of love from the fans of his works; it will always be free and will never profit from his creations.
row.short_description: The Genesis Project is an attempt to replicate Sburb from the popular webcomic Homestuck, made by Andrew Hussie.

row.name: Descent: Legends of the Dark
row.detailed_description: *A companion app for the Descent: Legends of the Dark board game from Fantasy Flight Games. Forge your own legend together with your friends as you adventure across the vibrant fantasy realm of Terrinoth! Powered by its fully integrated free companion app, Descent: Legends of the Dark puts you in the role of a budding hero with their own playstyle and abilities. Together with your unlikely companions, you’ll begin an unexpected adventure for one to four players! To play the Descent: Legends of the Dark board game, one player must download the free Descent: Legends of the Dark app on a compatible device. This companion app determines the setup of each quest, tracks your party’s inventory, skills, progress, and resolves combat while telling a narrative story of our heroes braving the exciting forests, dangerous dungeons, and majestic landscapes of Terrinoth. The app also lets the heroes save their campaign, allowing them to complete it over the course of several gaming sessions.
row.short_description: To play the Descent: Legends of the Dark board game, one player must download the free Descent: Legends of the Dark app on a compatible device. This companion app determines the setup of each quest, tracks your party’s inventory, skills, progress, and resolves combat while telling a narrative story.

row.name: The Cube Factory
row.detailed_description: The Cube Factory has a new line of evil cube-like robots, it's up to you to take them out. Shoot your way into and out of the factory, don't leave a single cube alive! You'll have to traverse the map by running along walls, hitting switches, and launching yourself across platforms all while keeping your aim at your enemy! The game is relatively short and there are some secrets on the levels if you decide to explore!
row.short_description: Shoot your way through evil cube-like robots while running along walls and jumping across platforms!
